Fellow patriot,

We just inched ahead of Sherrod Brown in the latest poll, but this is no time to get comfortable. If we think for a second that this is over – if we take our foot off the gas even a little – the radical left will come roaring back with everything they’ve got.

**You know it. I know it. The swamp _always_ fights dirty. **

I’m writing to you today because we deserve better. Just this evening, I heard the harrowing story of a young couple eagerly expecting their hoped for second child and who instead experienced a nightmare. In her 13th week of pregnancy and after her baby’s heart had stopped more than a week earlier, this young mom almost died because her doctors were terrified of giving her the life-saving care that she needed. Despite several trips to the emergency room, and only after she was unconscious and near death did this young mom finally receive the care that she needed. Women’s lives are literally on the line. And we need federal protections to insure that women who need care don’t die. This is why I’m supporting my friend, pro-choice champion Michelle Vallejo, for Congress in TX-15. In one of the most flippable seats in the country, we have a chance to come together and say, “enough” to this inhumane control over women’s most personal and life-saving decisions. Everything is on the line, Peter. In Texas, anti-choice Republicans like Michelle’s extremist opponent have forced women to flee out of state to receive reproductive care — IF they are fortunate enough to do so. Her anti-choice opponent celebrated when Roe v. Wade was overturned and supports letting Texas send doctors and nurses to prison for performing life-saving abortions. It’s time we replace these MAGA extremists with pro-choice leaders who will fight for women and our personal freedoms. That’s why I’m supporting Michelle. See, I didn't earn their support with false promises, _[or even flashy TikToks](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93507317/500746236/-1496313371?_t=8pVCYUmFRl9&_r=1&refcode=jtk1970-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGMxMzRkOTktZTI3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W3J2fHkQMHD-S-cedHrw942m0gxUU9k45pdY-IwQEBI=&emci=be938113-5474-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=8c134d99-e27a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=3969733)_ — **I'm filling lecture halls and tailgates because my people-first message aligns with their priorities.**
**They care about reproductive rights:** Young women want the right to choose what they do with their own bodies. Young men don’t want to worry about their partners’ health. And they _all_ want to protect access to contraception options and the extra level of safety it provides.
**They care about strengthening gun control:** College is stressful enough as it is. The last thing students need to worry about is finding the nearest exit in case a shooter enters the dining hall or the classroom.
**They care about the affordability crisis:** Working families across Florida are already struggling to make ends meet — and for students looking ahead to repaying thousands in student loans after graduation, while home ownership already seems out of reach and rents are on the rise, something's got to give.
**They care about education:** Florida's students have stood on the frontlines of the GOP's extremist crackdowns on the freedom to speak, learn, and live freely. They're sick of the book bans, the fear-mongering, the propaganda, and the division — and they're not afraid to confront ugly truths.
**They care about the climate:** Sea levels are rising, and parts of our state are sinking. As our students work hard to carve a path to a brighter future, they're grappling with the fear that unless we act now, there might not even be a _liveable_ future to look forward to here in Florida.

It’s no secret that Mitch McConnell is determined to defeat me. He personally recruited a wealthy out-of-stater to run in this race, and his buddies are spending nearly $90 million to smear my record.
**I hate to say it, folks, but that spending is working: Polls are tied.** Now we have less than three weeks until Montanans start voting. You can bet Mitch McConnell’s buddies will throw everything but the kitchen sink at us to win this race.

name: Riley Gaines
subject: It's getting hard to hold back this evil
body:
I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

| |
---
| | I’m writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.
---
| |

| |

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlhe3r3gnof21nfpck6n9o447f3ea9580e6qg7bg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative,
---
| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvi42cnhn0ku26tvt4u018n93s441j1nfe104840_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)
---
| | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. **[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6adlngegv7d2lhmdcndne5otmukhfistto7tq8o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare."_Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women."_ It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word."_Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot."_ Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.**God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that.** Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... I don't want you looking back with regret wishing you had done something when you still had a chance.**Your chance is right now -- and right by my side.** **[Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making an urgent tax-deductible donation today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zre8533l00mciuum1kg5oi2rfvdgnaisfo7nmndg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs) ** Maybe you're thinking like so many, "Riley, adults are free to do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents."I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, "No."
---
>> But parents in MD had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a "girl." >> Parents in Vermont are seeing their foster care licenses revoked because they admit they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery.>> Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them. >> And Illinois is considering a bill that would change the definition of "child abuse" to include parents who oppose puberty blocking drugs and sex change operations.
---
The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. **It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty.** **[And your tax-deductible gift today is going straight to help them.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3sgiv55l4deo44klhd2l33lkc61o8459j015qrg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** With the help of patriots like you, the _Center for American Liberty_ fights the transgender movement _in the courts_ because that’s the only way to stop them. And the _Center for American Liberty_ is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.
---
**#1. They're fighting radical schools**.
---
I know it may sound crazy to you but in today's taxpayer-funded schools, teachers and counselors _encourage_ young children to socially "transition" at school and then facilitate the "transition" by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex.And they keep it all a secret from parents! The _Center for American Liberty_ is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win! **[When you make your tax-deductible gift today](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkiv9scv5vhploit5mmtbplug4lcqsfq32ahbi4g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs), **you're making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals!
---
**#2. They're fighting radical doctors.**
---
There are doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender "care." They use their "expertise" to convince _even_ _conservative_ _parents_ that if they oppose "transition," their child will commit suicide.Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children's healthy breasts and other parts. Maybe you've seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the _Center for American Liberty_ is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15. **[**When you make your tax-deductible gift today**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0jq0o220thvk1ask4an22scaqkj2elbbcfa0m90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** , you're helping Chloe and the _Center for American Liberty_ make sure this never happens to another child!
---
**#3. They're fighting for _your_ right to speak out against this evil.**
---
Fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the _Center for American Liberty's_ specialties and they've notched plenty of victories in this space. Their next one is going to be fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women's bathing suit was in the women's locker room "helping" two little girls get ready to use the bathroom.And she was the one punished!**[**When you make your tax-deductible gift today**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp567v1ivjbhhf67ucj05domu60n67s5unvaljv8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** , you're helping the _Center for American Liberty_ protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you.**[But all I'm asking you to do is make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbr9rm3rq3u3alffm4pph68ans4evgson9qemego_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. _The Center for American Liberty_ needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... I**t will be my honor to send you my new book _Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind_ as my free gift** **[**when you donate $100 or more to the Center for American Liberty.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zo91ank4anoio9kjj9kr1l1geudos1t8tri8m8o0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: _For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18_ I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Riley Gaines
---
|
---

The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the _Center for American Liberty's_ work, **[when you donate $100 or more, as my personal "Thank You," I'll send you my new book,_Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind_ for free.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1sp9oe07ns1gr501eprgot83vq7qk1g6089t5ko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c9im6or6cjh2bs)** Please hurry. It's getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don't want you to look back a year from now and say, "I wish I had done something when I had the chance."

And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents."I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, "No." > But parents in MD had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a "girl." >> Parents in Vermont are seeing their foster care licenses revoked because they admit they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery.>> Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them. >> And Illinois is considering a bill that would change the definition of "child abuse" to include parents who oppose puberty blocking drugs and sex change operations. The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty. With the help of patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them. And the Center for American Liberty is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach. #1. They're fighting radical schools. I know it may sound crazy to you but in today's taxpayer-funded schools, teachers and counselors encourage young children to socially "transition" at school and then facilitate the "transition" by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex.And they keep it all a secret from parents! The Center for American Liberty is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win! , you're making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals! #2. They're fighting radical doctors. There are doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender "care." They use their "expertise" to convince even conservative parents that if they oppose "transition," their child will commit suicide.Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children's healthy breasts and other parts. Maybe you've seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the Center for American Liberty is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15. , you're helping Chloe and the Center for American Liberty make sure this never happens to another child! #3. They're fighting for your right to speak out against this evil. Fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the Center for American Liberty's specialties and they've notched plenty of victories in this space. Their next one is going to be fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women's bathing suit was in the women's locker room "helping" two little girls get ready to use the bathroom.And she was the one punished! , you're helping the Center for American Liberty protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you. Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... It will be my honor to send you my new book Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind as my free gift Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18 I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too. Sincerely, | | Riley Gaines | | | P.S. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the Center for American Liberty's work, Please hurry. It's getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don't want you to look back a year from now and say, "I wish I had done something when I had the chance." | | | | | | ---|--- The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. © The Center for American Liberty | PO Box 200942, Pittsburgh, PA 15251 | ICYMI News PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

## Growing Storm Threatens Florida, Southeast
Tropical Storm Helene [is rapidly intensifying](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuwzAMAL_G3hxQtB7VoKFLtnTtaFASFbNQbENRE_Tvi3TueLjlcJ-X5UJSZbt-0I1DL_tCqcuDFz-hmVAvesyhMCPPIwfl0KGbldPjGhRRTooVOCIVo_cmpcKUGcHPOrtRAgJq8GgUgEN7ApshefLGW5UjmEEDZ-l7O33tsvWVS_3ZH9xOab-NNay9H_dhfh_wPOCZjo2f95d6QeuSKg947m0_JFGdnkx95Tat361Joo2nRE1iZNqm5KIDSnZWbEoyubxZDxAts9KqRDO2kI-n1Cp36wYN1xtJ_avo_z95BPwNAAD__5PCY_I) in the Caribbean Sea and could become a major hurricane before making landfall on the Florida coast late Thursday.The storm threatens to bring catastrophic storm surge up to 15 feet, heavy rainfall, and winds potentially exceeding 111 mph, with impact expected to extend far inland across the southeastern U.S. [Here's a live tracker](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj8FqxCAUAL9GbxueT6P14KFQcttCD-3SUzDxubGYuGTdhPx92Z57nYGBuZz7s085Ldd3P5OrsfR-rGmj3p6wPaHqFQ8uEiFJTk4YNGikMIpPDsFHUkqTEQTBWuXRixal0BRR-BeeHAIqsNgKAIO6AR1gtN62VoswQMsUUEi1rM1PSUudKOajbLQ2Y5l5dlOttzuTrww7ht2-781RHvUx0NM_ia_jxGS3MflWLscSP79w-P7gqwu3PeWc7towBdfZp_yXrP8Pbg5_AwAA__834lG0). Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis has declared a state of emergency in 61 counties, while hurricane watches span parts of Florida, Cuba, and Mexico.Officials are urging residents in evacuation zones to leave, emphasizing that such extreme storm surge "[is NOT survivable](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOpCAURp8GOwxcULSg2MZutt3SgFxGJggTvI7Zt9_M1n_3JV9ycnL-PNaHSzmV5293oKVYV7dR-uA6cxg46FV3wUZEQNWhlQYMGCWN7nYroozaA05-0kqp6KYgpYl-8tKjCLJLFgRoMcMghTAw9mIMYpvdPMyjDF4MTAsMiWrrXzUV2jHmv_WDrd_q0WW7E71Ppn4xWBgs9333W_Hb92SwfNEMFjF_t2KwnPWiHd1J_Dr5VQI2frhXbfyk2g5-u1ZSefJYG39XwkLJZb5fraXNFex3OnLXbHjfKed0joZp8Txcyv9l6Oc0Hwv_AgAA__92vGbD)."
## Russian Jets Spotted Near Alaska
Four Russian [military aircraft entered Alaska's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFy6yAQQNGvkTo0aEFIFBSvcefXptSsxWJvjIQHsBn_fSZp0qQ_xZ37cV7PyJGP63_cydWQVtwqv2i1AiYBetW9d4EISPXkxhlmmNU46_7mLKgwXrQJcgG9GVpAK68WpKAXtRjZswMJWlqYRilnMIM0Xm4W7WTN6C9y6rQkzzXl4TPxUW8U4ju9KA9b2vvobrU-Sqf-dXDq4NRaGw5qpRHdv0EHp5CeWeRnKYyH2DlyxfwWyHnLGKooj1QreXEQZoERyx3FkTJ68Sy_fLTToqTqs_OPxjFyMXOn5XVHjj8h9e8tLwdfAQAA__9dFmYo) Air Defense Identification Zone on Monday, remaining in international airspace without breaching U.S. or Canadian territory, NORAD reported.The identification zone is international airspace where aircraft must identify themselves.This [latest incursion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGngY0IztiEgaGLt3TtaF3NOb4WgwU0Vd6-aufOv_QP39ttuSEnzvdXPCj0rSy4dn7Q4hWMCuxiZQwbEdAgKRgHDtxgnJV72MbBjNGjtxAdThYR7FUPiAYmC_4qOYAGqz2MRmsH00VPUa8e_egnE9_1KKymyL3Uy0fh3Hfa0rM8qF7WcsgU9t7PJoYXAbOAue-0c0q_TcB8lsTrU8AcaaPcSMBsr94ZM6j61RpjVgcn7lif6kyYqalMWBUmbJ8oYJY1xPObU-I2OWH1_UD-m8v-P8MjwE8AAAD__x4ZXns) comes after the U.S. deployed about 130 soldiers to Alaska in response to a spike in Russian military activity in the area.NORAD also confirmed that Monday's detection was [the fifth such incident](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGnwRsWHLCxB4YrXXnLXa6qjtYJHCenxSYCmih9-qqdO__Lr-_1tJ6QEx-Xf7iTb1teMTS-0zpLGCTY1XbRb0RApiOvHThwRjvbXf2IcNYhjOBMHBwNYCaYoovWaaOtUx17UGDVDINWysHYqzGqMOM8zKOOZzUIqyhyy6V_y3y0K23pme9U-pD3Lvlra7cqzB8Bi4AFz-GgR-0v-TsLWF7-C1isLB-1Mh5y58QNy1Mil1BwazJSo9AoSkxY31FG2uioJD_zQQKW2nJ5CrNwFOav1mYe1DSZrvh4e3BKXEcnrLrsyOlnqP3Oc_fwFQAA__9nYmYi) in September but maintained the U.S. military remains ready to defend its territory.

The U.S. remains the leading nation in the world in terms of overall power and per capita strength, according to a new ranking of the [world's biggest superpowers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GSrCAQAL8GMywcEdaA4CVm-9ILrVHGde5YsYCVur-_2osv76ru_rjPd-TAx-M_PsmVLc64Fr5oHiUMEvSsG-82IqC-IddZsGD7zupmd8NiltX3aDdct_EGRhvb9bq_DcuikG4NO1Cg1QhDp5QF0yrj1TriOIym84sahFbkucTUfkY-yk5b-I4XpXaNzya4vZQzi_6fgEnAVGttL84vDCueXDBwLm9QwJTw-OLjIctOssYUfJb5dVI6Y6WUJR_yHSJgapLzZ-UQOBsrtHo8kcOvrfz9fjn4CQAA__9lGFzI). Based on data collected from the [Great Powers Index](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71qwzAQAOCnkbcY-SJb9qAhUAwdUkqXjkLRnZMrsk7YIj9vX-jcJ_j4vs_-HDhxvn6ElVxdxIdY-U5-OkB_AONNg24hAjo25DoLFuyxs6a5uTEOmsaAy4TjeCFjhxBx7LsY0CB2fcMONBg9Qd9pbWFo9YA6TmHqp6HDi-6V0YRcZWt_hHO90ZJecqetjbI2yd1qLbs6nhTMCmaKkmXlWDbOkUuivZXtqmBGeeQkAXcF81tILF_h5T_lQZt_z0hPfyqFMvKzLbg0m8Py4JR4H6wy-roGTn9e_X9_d_AbAAD__9HoXyk), the top 24 countries were ranked by GDP, trade, education, and military strength.The U.S. earned an 89 in total strength and a 71 in per capita strength, topping both categories, with a significant lead in per capita power. Rounding out the top five are China, Eurozone, Germany, and Japan. ## Paxton Challenges Lizard's Status
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton filed a lawsuit against the Biden administration Monday challenging the government's [designation of the dunes sagebrush lizard](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8Gb0RwBmwGhi7e0rWjhc0RTsI4sk9J2q-vmr3zk96T3td1vkaq1G6fccPAr7zPcWV64OwlWAlmNl0Ki0pedxj0AAM4N2jflbD22i0KtFEWlVN6BGX7cQHV-wQ5x44CKDDKg9XKul5f8rpAHDH7PDgHYxJGYSLejwsXZHzFM9fv_YHHZd23robCfD9F_yFgEjBxwUK1_jEBU9k3bPg8BUwnR0b5jLwWAZMZvbWul2-fXChhkzFt1OjkIzLtTVb6iUeS2FJsNzwwCZi6I6T7k2ql0w3CqNsW6d3q-J8tjwC_AQAA__8fr2Wo) as an endangered species. Paxton labeled it an "unlawful misuse of environmental law" and a "backdoor attempt to undermine Texas's oil and gas industries." In its designation, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service said the lizard had [suffered habitat loss](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-N2YzswzZ48NCFLV07Iid3Tk4yOAI30P76iuzdnvRJT5_e12W6RM683D_jTKEeqUzxVvlFk5dgJZjJNBiuCr1uKOgeenCu1755hMHZYUjYWes7JO2dJ6OMVjRgsgZswwEUGOXBamVdp9t0u0IcKPnUOwcDCqMIuZa1rQ-qdMQt5Z_yorW9lbnJ4VHrcxPdh4BRwLjvexsPLtu5ChhPuYBR-ZNPehvklZEWGXHmhbe6xsplkZl_44qSFozLnVZCWTjLHPftm2uzBnzunDNvrhdG3efI-X2h_lPkFeAvAAD__9eZY3w) in much of the Permian Basin due to activity associated with oil and gas production. Paxton claims the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service made "inaccurate and arbitrary assumptions" about the lizard's status and argues the agency has [overlooked conservation efforts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAURb8Gd1jwgsEuKLZxl223tID3sNESOwISZ-brRxNpyqmv7pHO-Xddri7ltK9_3Y1se8VjcaGlJy0Th4GDWlSH1gucZEdWGjCgtZFTt1llEEYdnTR-iOS98sJo7-UkIwbE2CULApSYYJBi0BfZx-DBjRSnaLSGEZkShKkdpW8bNXq5GvPH8aTSh-PWZbu1dq_s8ofBzGA-z7P_vx2P75HB7EpLIRODeaezMpjzEVxmML9BDGZ87FR5dSv58qgbz-nTFeR392rHzmOqGz9TxpwicdrR7SsVQv5zh3HgHgVoAMWjjpEr9Mh9GALXfhIUzIXMYLpi8X6mnFPVhimx3lzKb4H2S8-nha8AAAD__wX8eVo) undertaken by state officials, landowners, and industry partners.
## Education Chief Backs Student Phone Ban
Texas Education Agency Commissioner Mike Morath has called for a [statewide ban on cell phones](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPozAQBeBfYzojewImFC6uocu1V6KxPQTrjAdhb0j-_Yrtt3vFk76n9-8xPzCmmJ9_cSNb3wvP6Gt80TxK6CV0c9cE61QYdUNWDzCAMYMem9V2hE5BuPsRteo8ul5BCIMjNOBQmyZaUNCpEXqtenPT7eId4J2WcRmMgXsQnaIQKx9tXanSG8uSPvyio_W8Ncmute5F3P4ImARM53m2PkX_H1b-KpXz1RIwZTqLgCmxxyRgukwBkxqvrAVMlVB63rZYSuRMh6Qc-ChUZKlY6YyBpKeU5L5yJukwy51T9B8Zs_QJSzmYt4toDhv2M6YUixlEp54bxvSztf5y3cvCdwAAAP__oplzMg) in classrooms, citing them as a distraction harmful to student learning. Morath [urged action on the issue](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAUAL8GOw28RZCC4hq7vfZKg_hYSJ5ghKy7f3-57a-fTCbzc1_uLlHKj2-3o22vUBbnW3riYnoYe5CL7Da78s2IDq3QoEEpLUwXrTQyAKoxeKW93FauvETjAleTB42qSxY4SG5gFHxUNzEEv4KbMJiglYJpY5Ljllo5hxax4cvVQO_yxHPwZe_IxtaOym5fDGYG83Vdw_6uLrvcSk7lD2IwZ7wqg5mKd8RgdmdLnpDB7JHoiCVjv7rcf_R99bEUqr0welJCjsMRj-6023ElolSVZpI_dpfoU9D-GfK08BsAAP__7gxkVg) during a Texas Senate Education Committee hearing last week. Several school districts across the state have implemented student cell phone bans. Teacher surveys indicate strong support for these measures, though some parents have expressed concerns about being unable to reach their children in an emergency. State Rep. Ellen Troxclair (R-Boerne) has said she'll file legislation to [enact a classroom cell phone ban](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOrCAYRp8GOgz8MigFxW3s5rZbGoSfkSyIEaLu229m-u2-4js5OV_P-Wljitvrv81o2h3KbF2LJ86awYOBnCX1ZuFeC4pGDDCAUoPQdDXBcsm5dmHUIKSTS784jkqhDV71XtBogIPkGh6CP1QvuuAWsCMGHQalYPREcvSxlaNrKza8bQ3pp5x4dK5kmsza2l5J_4_ARGC6rqsL5ZYbXvV9IDC9J4HpgzKHKbF9LRuyxW7MJVvrUUpmOX4jy-WwbaWH8fsVU4pVDUTyV7YxfWztj_jTwG8AAAD__31JXqE) across the state at the start of the next legislative session in January.
## Doritos Challenges Fans To Create Super Bowl Ad
Plano-based Frito-Lay is bringing back its iconic [Crash the Super Bowl contest,](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQgOGnwRsWnG2wB4Yu3tK1o4XhCKgYInNykrev2r37L_3S93XbbjblVO6f9kBDr1A36yhduC0cJg7jNnbe7MIvskMjNWhQSsuli8aFeQA3Kzc5F3bcZfAW5iCHoMHqRXbJgIBRLDBJMalB9sHtYGcMS9BKwezZKNAnqmdPEQlftoX8rheevatHl00kejQ2fDBYGawhFVsc9m8ba_0tGKwFn43BSjGVb74jEZ7c1zNRbdxFmzOWOzYebGlcjkIIMaupj3Tk7jT-8Uw5p6Y0G8X9sCn_fekfhsvATwAAAP__ZydhMg) challenging Doritos fans to create a commercial for the brand to air during the Big Game, with a $1 million prize for the winner. Friend,

You probably didn’t wake up this morning and think, “ _Today's the day I’m going to make a $10 donation to DMP's campaign!_ ” — **but ahead of my final quarterly FEC deadline of the race, it's what I’m about to ask you to do.**
Unlike Rick Scott, I don't have a massive fortune at my campaign's disposal. I come from a working-class family, so I know my eye-watering **$6 million EOQ goal** is nothing to shake a stick at. But it's the only way I'll be able to defeat him.
**_[If that's all you need to hear, please click here to chip in $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93511246/500753058/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk1988-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQzOTQ5ZmQtMmQ3Yi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NaiLOgSWI195DsEXVWZJ8V4VzJyOFI3WQn1VC1tsAtw=)_ **— **but I'd like to share what your hard-earned $10 means to me.**
See, my family moved to the US from Ecuador with big dreams for a better life when I was 14. But it didn't come easy, and despite my mom working back-to-back double shifts, we still struggled to afford rent on our one room apartment.
**So once I turned 15, I began taking early morning shifts at a doughnut shop before school.** It wasn't much, but the extra cash gave my family room to breathe, and eventually, the life we dreamt of finally came true.
But I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, _**bought**_ two doughnut shops.
While I made minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, he reaped the benefits of his employees' hard work.
**For me, those $10 boxes of doughnuts were a lifeline that helped my family get by. For him, they kicked off a career in penthouse C-suites.**
**_[And with your $10, you can help me kick Rick out of the Senate on election night — so please, pitch in now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93511248/500753059/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk1988-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQzOTQ5ZmQtMmQ3Yi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NaiLOgSWI195DsEXVWZJ8V4VzJyOFI3WQn1VC1tsAtw=)_ **
| | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93511251/500753060/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk1988-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQzOTQ5ZmQtMmQ3Yi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NaiLOgSWI195DsEXVWZJ8V4VzJyOFI3WQn1VC1tsAtw=)

I went on to graduate college, fight to improve life for working families like my own, and become the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to enrich himself off U.S. taxpayers via the largest Medicare fraud scheme in history, amass a nine-figure fortune, and buy his way into the Senate.
**So I don't take your help toward reaching my $6 million end-of-quarter goal lightly.** There's simply no way I could ever do it on my own.
My opponent, however, can spend $6 million to get his ads on screens without thinking twice — _and he has already spent plenty more to stop me._
**_So th[e only way we'll get him out and give working Floridians the Senate representation we deserve is if we hit my $6 million goal by Sept. 30. Earlier this week, I attended a hearing about the proposed 2,000-acre solar farm in Pontotoc County, Mississippi. Over 50 local residents were present at the hearing, which was led by Public Service Commissioner Chris Brown.
The community's concerns were valid, focusing on how such a massive project would affect their property, way of life, and the future of their area. What struck me the most was the misinformation being spread by the very people entrusted with representing Pontotoc County citizens. Many residents had contacted their county supervisors, only to be told that these officials had no involvement in the project. However, it became clear during the hearing that this wasn't true. In fact, the project cannot move forward without the unanimous approval of the county supervisors, which directly contradicts what they had been telling the public.
Solar energy has long been heralded as a key solution to the global challenge of reducing carbon emissions and transitioning to cleaner, renewable energy sources. While some believe solar energy is a critical component of the future energy mix, large solar farms also bring with them a number of potential drawbacks, both environmentally and economically, that must be carefully considered. Here are some of the primary negatives associated with large solar farms:
#### 1\. **Land Use and Habitat Destruction**
One of the most significant issues with large-scale solar farms is the amount of land they require. Solar farms are land-intensive projects. In areas where land is a scarce or valuable resource, such as agricultural regions, the installation of large solar farms can displace farming activities, potentially leading to reduced local food production and harm to rural economies.
Beyond the economic concerns, the environmental impact can be equally damaging. The large tracts of land needed for solar farms often involve clearing habitats that support wildlife, potentially disrupting ecosystems. Deserts, where many large solar farms are located, may seem barren, but they are home to a range of species adapted to the harsh environment. Building solar farms in these areas can destroy habitats for plants and animals, potentially threatening endangered species.
#### 2\. **Energy Efficiency and Intermittency**
While solar energy is clean, it is also intermittent. Solar farms only produce electricity during daylight hours, and their efficiency is impacted by weather conditions, cloud cover, and the angle of sunlight. At night or during overcast days, solar farms cannot generate energy, necessitating the use of battery storage or backup power sources like natural gas plants. This intermittency can be particularly problematic on a large scale, where consistent, reliable energy supply is crucial for maintaining grid stability.
Moreover, large solar farms tend to be less efficient compared to small, localized solar installations. The further the energy travels from the solar farm to its point of use, the more energy is lost in transmission. This inefficiency can offset some of the environmental benefits, especially when the infrastructure to store and transport the energy is insufficient.
#### 3\. **Environmental Impact of Manufacturing and Disposal**
The production of solar panels is not without environmental cost. The process of manufacturing solar panels involves mining and processing minerals such as silicon, silver, and rare earth elements. These materials are often extracted in countries with less stringent environmental regulations, leading to environmental degradation, water contamination, and significant carbon emissions from mining operations.
In addition, solar panels have a finite lifespan, typically lasting around 25 to 30 years. At the end of their life cycle, they need to be disposed of or recycled. Currently, the recycling infrastructure for solar panels is still underdeveloped, and a large proportion of old panels could end up in landfills, contributing to environmental pollution.
#### 4\. **Impact on Local Communities**
Large solar farms can have mixed effects on the communities they are built in. While they may bring temporary jobs during construction, these are often not long-term. Once operational, solar farms require minimal staff to maintain. In some cases, communities may feel that the aesthetic impact of large solar farms, which can cover hundreds or even thousands of acres, detracts from the natural beauty of the landscape. This can lead to reduced property values and decreased tourism in areas that depend on natural vistas.
#### Conclusion
The challenges of land use, energy intermittency, environmental impacts of manufacturing, and the effects on local communities highlight the need for a balanced approach. In order to fully benefit from solar energy, it is crucial to weigh these negatives against the positives and to continue developing more efficient, less disruptive ways of harnessing solar power. Decentralized solar installations, improvements in battery storage, and advances in recycling technology are just some of the ways that solar energy must evolve to minimize these drawbacks.

The USO Home Team is our exclusive group of the most passionate USO supporters, and joining it is the most impactful way to help our service members.
That's because USO Home Team supporters are key players in providing our critical programs and services to military members and families. Day after day, they ensure we're prepared to mobilize quickly any time our service members are called to respond to emergencies around the world or natural disasters here at home.
By joining the USO Home Team today, you'll help us continue our 83-year legacy of providing the best for our nation's heroes, from entertainment and essential supplies on difficult deployments to ways of connecting with families back home.

subject: Thank Nebraska State Senator Mike McDonnell for doing the right thing and protecting our fair elections
body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
# [Thank this Nebraska state senator for blocking a Republican effort to steal an electoral vote from Kamala Harris](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td6afbba6-795e-4e28-8661-c9a75ee3eecc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T35d8cb96-1efc-4679-9563-373b0ecffe48/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Nebraska Republican Mike McDonnell just did the right thing, blocked an effort to steal an electoral vote from Harris, and may well have kept Trump from the White House. _The Nebraska state senator who Republicans hoped would help ease former President Donald J. Trump's path to the White House by agreeing to change how the state allocates its Electoral College votes said on Monday that he would not do so, ending a brief but intense lobbying effort from allies of Mr. Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris._ _The state legislator, Mike McDonnell, a Democrat turned Republican from Omaha, said that he would not agree to change Nebraska's 32-year tradition of awarding three of the state's five electoral votes by congressional district to a winner-take-all system based on the statewide popular vote, bucking calls from Nebraska's governor and its congressional delegation to help Mr. Trump._ _" I respect the desire of some of my colleagues to have this discussion, and I have taken time to listen carefully to Nebraskans and national leaders on both sides of the issue. After deep consideration, it is clear to me that right now, 43 days from Election Day, is not the moment to make this change."_ _Mr. McDonnell said he had told the state's Republican governor, Jim Pillen, that "I will not change my long-held position and will oppose any attempted changes to our Electoral College system before the 2024 election." (source: [NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T94b3b154-4f1a-4f63-8b96-bd7a53752a2c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ This was the right thing to do, since re-writing the rules to throw a vote to Trump would have been profoundly unfair. And it could have been a game changer, given how close this race is. And it took guts to do it, since he's no doubt catching hell from Trump supporters right now. So let's let him know that real Americans -- who care about fair elections -- appreciate what he has done. [**Add your name, and join us in saying thank you to Nebraska State Senator Mike McDonnell.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbed526fb-96bd-451e-868d-c847ec99b3d7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations has teamed up with Mexico to SUE American gun manufacturers for the out-of-control crime in lawless Mexico.

Not only are they suing, but they’re DEMANDING a ban on production of semi-automatic AR-15 and AK-47-style weapons.

And this case has the backing of the Biden-Harris Administration!

But we still have a chance to stop this this madness in its tracks – **[if you’ll agree to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court by signing your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM immediately](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=6ncbeg2qrdiu6j0mv4885sh7mzuc2asdncbrrbl32f921m3jiu0sbbxvl171232e2yl495ropqf0t2rbtzl0fhgnu5fpfj5h9etehnx6lst00fq5zycmoipo32rpc49l0wmyd1x623cxz0yeue3r450nc8rzlz4a8z0845b4e7u1ctgmixsm3dqm6nz2gxz4qipr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skdeeb&__onlt=h)**.

Please read Dudley’s Brown’s email below about this dangerous UN-Mexico lawsuit against U.S. gun manufacturers. And take action!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Dear Fellow Patriot,

With the full backing of the United Nations and the blessing of the Biden-Harris Administration, the country of Mexico just filed a court case that could finally impose the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on America.

If successful, this lawsuit would effectively allow foreign dictators to dictate gun policy in the United States – _resulting in the swift death of our Second Amendment freedoms_.

You see, Fellow Patriot, Mexico – a country that’s signed on to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” – is mad that disarming law-abiding citizens across their country has resulted in violent drug cartels controlling up to 35% of the country (_according to a 2022 U.S. Senate resolution_).

Instead of blaming their own draconian gun laws (_as they should_), they’re suing U.S. gun manufacturer _Smith & Wesson_.

But not for any __AMERICAN LAW__ any of Smith & Wesson broke...

**Mexico is suing this gun manufacturer for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexican criminals...**

**...As if there was any way a firearms manufacturer could have predicted their firearms would be illegally trafficked!**

That’s not all: Mexico is also asking the courts to _BAN the production and sale of AR-15 and AK-47-style rifles_.

_And the Boston-based First Circuit Court of Appeals just announced this case can proceed!_

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court to help me stop this madness IMMEDIATELY](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=6ncbeg2qrdiu6j0mv4885sh7mzuc2asdndtuacabo4s8cwzpmwsglatfiv8m8c64tigwievhvuvelv2dvokog3ha3q1scmv4js78g2gh2t7uwik0awbvzmoiml5sgti1l2dl8gpeww8jms46m8f38ja6meg14y1gw5l425z09u86r0rllh46fsw93ymjfluel8fu&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skdeeb&__onlt=h)**.

As you’ll see, this _CIVIS DIRECTIVUM_ – Latin for “Citizen’s Directive” – demands that the United States Supreme Court: **1)_Immediately dismisses the case_** , forbidding it from proceeding to trial; **2)_Sends a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message_** that _NO FOREIGN ENTITY_ will ever have standing to file lawsuits related to our Second Amendment freedoms in U.S. courts. PERIOD. Because if they don’t, it won’t be long until the United Nations gets their ultimate wish – which is the power to control the United States and our gun laws though the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty.”

And make no mistake.

**That’s what this new legal assault is really all about**.

In fact, after this case was filed, two separate UN-affiliated entities filed _amicus curae_ briefs with the First Circuit.

And the United Nations’ Office on Drugs and Crime issued a statement: _“This case exemplifies the illicit nature of a firearm transfer in circumstances in which weapons could be used to commit human rights violations, which fits into the broader trend of engaging the concept of complicity in developing legal standards for corporate accountability.”_ This is right out of the UN “Small Arms Treaty” playbook!

Following the Tenth Conference of State Parties in August, the United Nations has laid the groundwork to FORCE: *****_ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.**

The UN ultimately wants final say on whether any firearms transfer should be allowed. After all, they know guns in the hands of the “wrong” people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; *****_ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products_.**

Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That’s what the gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing; and *****_That ALL countries involved in the export of firearms – including the United States – establish a “National Control System_.” **

This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple – the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION. Now, Mexico is demanding that arms manufacturers provide them with full information on every gun sale! And this case out of the First Circuit Court of Appeals shows how serious they are about forcing the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on the United States – _especially while they still have a puppet in the White House_.

The fact is, President Biden took an oath to “defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.”

_But he’s said nothing as his anti-gun allies in the First Circuit are rolling out the red carpet for a FOREIGN COUNTRY – with the complete backing of the United Nations – to start hacking away at our Bill of Rights_!

As the Defendants in this case stated in a recent court filing: _“Mexico’s brazen attempt to regulate the American firearms industry based on its foreign interests poses a grave threat to the sovereignty of the United States, its citizens, and their Second Amendment rights.”_ But Joe Biden and Kamala Harris couldn’t care less – so long as it results in less freedom for you and me!

And while Mexico is blaming U.S. gun manufacturers for “allowing” guns to fall into the hands of drug cartels, _part of me wonders if it’s Biden’s ATF that’s truly to blame_.

You probably remember how, during the Obama administration, the ATF launched Operation Fast and Furious, where they stood by silently, allowing guns sold in the U.S. to be illegally trafficked to Mexican gangs – _until U.S. Border Patrol agent Brian Terry was killed with one of those guns_.

**Would you put something like this past this President, or even his potential predecessor – who would be the two most lawless, anti-gun Presidents in American history**?

That’s why I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action.

The good news is, even as I write you, National Association for Gun Rights’ attorneys are drafting a hard-hitting _amicus curae_ brief for the United States Supreme Court, insisting the Court: >>> Bars this case, which is currently residing at the U.S. District Court in Massachusetts, from moving forward to trial – and; >>> Sends a clear message that ANY and ALL foreign entities will forever be barred from filing lawsuits in American courts that seek to undermine our Second Amendment freedoms. But I’m counting on you to make sure we’re heard.

Yes, Fellow Patriot, this case should be an open and shut one.

_After the Supreme Court’s 2022 _Bruen_ decision, how could they possibly even think of siding with Mexico on this case_?

Well, that’s not really my fear...

My fear is that Chief Justice John Roberts twists enough arms on the Court to “punt” the case, allowing Mexico’s lawsuit before U.S. District Court in Massachusetts (_an extremely left-wing court_) to work itself out – with the intent of just getting to it later.

Since this case touches on international trade – something the Supreme Court typically avoids – I’m concerned that’s what the Court will do.

_And that’s exactly what the Biden-Harris Administration and their pals are banking on!_

They know court cases like this can often take YEARS.

**And by the time it comes back around to the Supreme Court, it may not be as friendly to our Second Amendment as it is now**.

That may happen sooner than you and I would like to believe . . .

_After all, the radical, anti-gun Left has been threatening to pack the U.S. Supreme Court ever since President Biden’s election_!

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please fill out your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name read – along with tens of thousands of other American patriots just like you – before the U.S. Supreme Court IMMEDIATELY](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=6ncbeg2qrdiu6j0mv4885sh7mzuc2asdnf1b6e3jgcgy55c82bpzvympdvmey0ofosxu82ejhc1q0sohycj0gvkp9gtyv19a8dy4dxq78uavb41ccsa282o0cexz3947i3ca8rl1xt9wxn2jf68ruulhrjydqvi777ihk5ud83are1zq6qs08gi6k7yzedm63jb5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skdeeb&__onlt=h)**.

Of course, in a perfect world, I wouldn’t have to ask you to do this...

But that’s not the one we live in.

_After all, you’ve heard how judges rule on the law and never take into account public opinion_.

But how many Supreme Court decisions can you rattle off the top of your head where justices got it completely backward?

The reason is that there are many judges who like to stick their fingers in the air to judge which way the political winds are blowing before they pick a side.

Worse, they often make those decisions based on what they see in the media and the swamp elites they rub shoulders with...

Fellow Patriot, it’s this bubble you and I have to break through.

**[That’s why your signed CIVIS DIRECTIVUM – along with a mountain of other signatures from Second Amendment supporters just like you – can help make all the difference](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=6ncbeg2qrdiu6j0mv4885sh7mzuc2asdnfferefw421egs9zsdg1fx6zb1o1ezs5dcskhbjt1fe6uiljariogdlbh2bbrqyjirnwcozhnvr297xxdqznusnwkbnc7ycmgy80c8da3jdi8cwnwyk3znzc0u14vufpuchdi5sybqqwsw939a3ikw25humue55gam58&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skdeeb&__onlt=h)**.

Would you put something like this past this President, or even his potential predecessor – who would be the two most lawless, anti-gun Presidents in American history? That’s why I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action. The good news is, even as I write you, National Association for Gun Rights’ attorneys are drafting a hard-hitting amicus curae brief for the United States Supreme Court, insisting the Court: >>> Bars this case, which is currently residing at the U.S. District Court in Massachusetts, from moving forward to trial – and; >>> Sends a clear message that ANY and ALL foreign entities will forever be barred from filing lawsuits in American courts that seek to undermine our Second Amendment freedoms. But I’m counting on you to make sure we’re heard. And the more signatures I can gather for this , the louder our message will be when tens of thousands of American gun owners have their names read before the U.S. Supreme Court. Yes, Fellow Patriot, this case should be an open and shut one. After the Supreme Court’s 2022 Bruen decision, how could they possibly even think of siding with Mexico on this case? Well, that’s not really my fear... My fear is that Chief Justice John Roberts twists enough arms on the Court to “punt” the case, allowing Mexico’s lawsuit before U.S. District Court in Massachusetts (an extremely left-wing court) to work itself out – with the intent of just getting to it later. Since this case touches on international trade – something the Supreme Court typically avoids – I’m concerned that’s what the Court will do. And that’s exactly what the Biden-Harris Administration and their pals are banking on! They know court cases like this can often take YEARS. And by the time it comes back around to the Supreme Court, it may not be as friendly to our Second Amendment as it is now. That may happen sooner than you and I would like to believe . . . After all, the radical, anti-gun Left has been threatening to pack the U.S. Supreme Court ever since President Biden’s election! . Of course, in a perfect world, I wouldn’t have to ask you to do this... But that’s not the one we live in. After all, you’ve heard how judges rule on the law and never take into account public opinion. But how many Supreme Court decisions can you rattle off the top of your head where justices got it completely backward? The reason is that there are many judges who like to stick their fingers in the air to judge which way the political winds are blowing before they pick a side. Worse, they often make those decisions based on what they see in the media and the swamp elites they rub shoulders with... Fellow Patriot, it’s this bubble you and I have to break through. . But I hope you won’t stop there. Given the stakes in this battle, I hope you’ll consider giving generously as well. You see, to make the biggest and LOUDEST possible impact at the Supreme Court, I need to alert Second Amendment supporters across the country to this threat. Needless to say, that won’t be cheap. But we have no choice. The UN is NOT going to stop with destroying our Second Amendment freedoms, Fellow Patriot – as if that wasn’t bad enough. Disarming us is just the first step, so we’ll be powerless to stop the rest of their schemes they plan to impose on us. You and I both know that. . . This may be far more than you’ve ever given. In fact, some members of my staff were concerned that asking you for that much might upset you. Fellow Patriot, I certainly don’t want to upset you. But I also know you’re a fellow pro-Second Amendment patriot and a friend – and I know I can count on you to at least consider giving this much if you can. If you can’t, I understand. . The United Nations is salivating at the thought of destroying our Second Amendment freedoms. It’s up to you and me to stop them. ! For Freedom, Dudley Brown President National Association for Gun Rights P.S. The country of Mexico – a signer of the United Nation’s “Small Arms Treaty” is suing Smith & Wesson for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexicans criminals... And the Boston-based First Circuit Court of Appeals just announced this case can proceed! This has the UN’s fingerprints all over it as they seek to impose the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on the United States! . name: Gavin Newsom
subject: I signed a bill restricting smartphone use in school
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
This new law will help students focus on academics, social development, and the world in front of them, not their screens, when they’re in school.

I signed a bill this week requiring every California school district, charter school and county office of education to adopt a policy limiting or prohibiting the use of smartphones by July 1, 2026.
This new law will help students focus on academics, social development, and the world in front of them, not their screens, when they’re in school.
The truth is, a majority of high school teachers and a high percentage of middle school teachers say that cell phones in classrooms are a major distraction.
We also know that excessive smartphone use increases anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues.
So we took action.
I know this is a divisive issue for some, but for us in California, I felt it was urgent to provide reasonable guidelines for smartphone use in school. And let me add, as part of this law, educators must allow students to use their phones in case of an emergency.
[**I've asked before, and I want to try again: what do you think about this? Do you agree or disagree with this legislation? Use this link to sound-off.**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/em-cell-phones-vote-sept24/?source=em240924-1-full&akid=2230%2E4767699%2EtLpCkz)

That's bad news for America. What it means is that a radical Democrat from New York, Hakeem Jeffries, would become Speaker. name: The Democratic Party
subject: A well-timed donation to the DNC is the best choice for those looking to help Democrats.
body:
We hope you'll give us a moment to explain.
---
If you are anything like us, your inbox is stuffed to the gills with fundraising requests from candidates and organizations asking you to donate before this FEC fundraising deadline. We hope you'll give us a moment to explain why a well-timed donation to the Democratic National Committee is the best choice for those looking to make a difference in this election. Here is the truth: This election is going to be decided by a relatively small number of voters in a relatively small number of states. That is true of the presidential election, and that is true when it comes to control of the House and Senate. That means going beyond the television ads to find those folks, talk to them, and either persuade them to vote for Democrats or convince infrequent Democratic voters to make sure they vote. And when you look at the DNC's top expense in our fundraising reports, it's that work. It is canvassing. It's conversations with those voters we need to win. That is not the flashy work -- it's the hard work. And you know that it's most often the hard work that makes the biggest difference in life. But that work is only possible if we have the resources to get it done. And most of the donations we receive come in response to emails like this one. So, with our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day coming up fast, we're asking: [**Can Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats running for office everywhere count on you to contribute to the DNC today? Pictured above are our powerful neighbors—residents of Delano Road—who successfully defeated plans to build a battery storage facility in 2021 and again in 2023. Yet, in 2024 when the council quietly voted behind their backs, their voices were ignored. This photo, taken by Adrianne Murchison for her piece, [Residents ready for legal fight to block battery energy storage plant - (CLICK HERE TO READ IT)](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjE3OTQyNzY3LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiMjNkZmVjNzdhZWExY2Q3NyJ9), captures their ongoing fight for justice.[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjI0MjM0MjI0LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiODJkODdlYzA2NTEwMDkxNCJ9)
|

| |

|
---
## What's happening with the NextEra Battery Storage Facility?
| | |
---
|
### Another day, another lawsuit...
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
Once again, residents find themselves in the unfortunate position of having to take legal action against the City of College Park due to their failure to follow proper procedures and address serious concerns from residents. A demand letter with a clear warning was sent to the City Attorney on **September 16th** , despite it pointing out **multiple procedural defects** in the [approval of NextEra’s lithium battery storage proposal (as highlighted in this AJC article)](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjI4NDI4NTI5LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiZTA4ZmYyNTFiNmVmYTZjZiJ9), the City has not responded. The deadline for action was **September 23rd** , and here we are—facing yet another costly lawsuit that could have been easily avoided.
| | |
---
|
### Key Issues Highlighted in the Letter:
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjM0NzE5OTg3LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiMDBiNmQwYTFkOTg4NTZkMCJ9)• **Lack of due process** : The [rezoning approval](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjM5OTYyODY4LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiOGExNWIxMmQ0NDI3OWY5MiJ9) on March 18, 2024, violated state law and the City’s own ordinances. A zoning decision based on such defective procedures is **legally void**. • **Public input ignored** : The City did not provide nearby residents with the required notices, removing their ability to voice concerns about the development. • **Confusion at the vote** : [Even members of the Council](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjQ1MjA1NzQ5LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiMDQ0NjI4M2Q0MzUzYzVlZSJ9) were not fully informed, as acknowledged by Councilmember Arnold at an open meeting.
|
---
|
# Read The Entire Letter
| | | | [ Click Here ](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjUxNDk3MjA2LFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiOTk1MjdmOGE4MTQ4M2YyZiJ9)
---
| | |
---
|
### One more thing...
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
These issues could have been addressed, but the City has chosen not to respond, leaving us no choice but to proceed with filing the petition. Once again, we see our tax dollars being wasted, all because the City fails to act in the best interests of its residents. It is because of the generosity of our neighbors that we’ve been able to secure legal representation and stand up for justice throughout our community. Money raised through [GoFundMe](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMzNDU1MzA4NjU3Nzg4NjYzLFwiclwiOjEzMzQ1NTMwOTQwMTIyODMwMX0iLCJzIjoiNzUyMmE2NjA5ZDY4NzdlZCJ9), along with additional funds contributed outside of the platform have gotten us this far. However, as the City of College Park continues down their destructive path, we must continue funding this important effort. We are deeply grateful to all who have given and to those who support us in other ways. Sincerely,
**United College Park

We must ask this question candidly and directly--did US Secretary of State Antony Blinken commit war crimes by knowingly lying to U.S. Congress and illegally sending arms to Netanyahu? A breaking detailed report from ProPublica indicates the strong and horrifying likelihood that the answer is yes. **Let 's Address This.**
Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. **Consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eBiuNSdF04Beo22ye_gWpZ6teN3Jj-skAIkTAK85y_0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=149381270)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1eb596c-6fe9-41ff-b475-1bbe5cb23cea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Pro justice protestors interrupt Blinken's Senate testimony. [Credit: Kent Nishimura/Getty Images]
ProPublica is a well respected non-profit media organization dedicated to authentic, verifiable, and reliable investigative journalism. Founded in 2007, it has already won six Pulitzer prizes, among numerous other awards. Non-partisan media watch dog organizations [consistently rate ProPublica as ](https://substack.com/redirect/58362aaa-6007-4d06-83de-845041007be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[reliable](https://substack.com/redirect/58362aaa-6007-4d06-83de-845041007be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. I offer this context lest critics attack ProPublica's reputation and credibility, which is beyond reproach. This week ProPublica published a detailed report [documenting the following](https://substack.com/redirect/5cf8c586-b6af-4833-938e-26a45b538444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The U.S. government's two foremost authorities on humanitarian assistance concluded this spring that Israel had deliberately blocked deliveries of food and medicine into Gaza. The U.S. Agency for International Development delivered its assessment to Secretary of State Antony Blinken and the State Department's refugees bureau made its stance known to top diplomats in late April. USAID sent Blinken a detailed 17-page memo on Israel's conduct. The memo described instances of Israeli interference with aid efforts, including killing aid workers, razing agricultural structures, bombing ambulances and hospitals, sitting on supply depots and routinely turning away trucks full of food and medicine. Days later, Blinken delivered a carefully worded statement to Congress that said, "_We do not currently assess that the Israeli government is prohibiting or otherwise restricting the transport or delivery of U.S. humanitarian assistance_."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d7eab7ff-81a9-4e73-a252-561f9e6c6aa4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some saw through Blinken's remarks immediately. [Senator Chris Van Hollen immediately condemned Blinken's testimony](https://substack.com/redirect/92d56f52-a747-4ccd-9581-e4801bac5250?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as contrary to established facts. And while the aforementioned USAID report was delivered to Blinken in April, it was not the first such indication of Israel's war crimes. Indeed, we knew this as early as October 23, 2023, when [Human Rights Watch reported](https://substack.com/redirect/a5afc46b-5146-43c3-9cdd-62c120c82a53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Israeli government is deliberately deepening the suffering of civilians in Gaza by refusing to restore the flow of water and electricity and blocking fuel shipments. Willfully impeding relief supplies is a war crime, as is collectively punishing civilians for the actions of armed groups.
Furthermore, in March of this year OxFam [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/2028b279-e07e-41c0-9ac2-0818ec723dfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Israeli authorities have rejected a warehouse full of international aid including oxygen, incubators and Oxfam water and sanitation gear all of which is now stockpiled at Al Arish just 25 miles away from the border of 2.3 million desperate Palestinians in Gaza. The reasons for rejection are not clear, says Oxfam. In a[ new report today](https://substack.com/redirect/2faac645-6bf4-4c3b-ac63-8c8c7e0ecd38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Oxfam said this rejected aid was just one example of an overall humanitarian response that Israel has made so dangerous and dysfunctional as to be impossible for aid agencies to work at the speed and scale necessary to save lives, despite best efforts. [Israel] is failing in its legal responsibilities to the people whose land it occupies and breaking one of the key provisions demanded by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) - to boost humanitarian aid in light of the risk of genocide in Gaza.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2969413-2009-4ff3-a88b-01693bec16cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eBiuNSdF04Beo22ye_gWpZ6teN3Jj-skAIkTAK85y_0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149381270)
Similarly, the US Aid report sent to Blinken [concluded](https://substack.com/redirect/5cf8c586-b6af-4833-938e-26a45b538444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Lifesaving food was stockpiled less than 30 miles across the border in an Israeli port, including enough flour to feed about 1.5 million Palestinians for five months, according to the memo. But in February the Israeli government had prohibited the transfer of flour, [saying its recipient was the United Nations' Palestinian branch](https://substack.com/redirect/942884c5-841c-4270-b4f6-1dbaf7d1c4dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that had been accused of having ties with Hamas.
But we also know this is a lie from Netanyahu. While falsely accusing Hamas of blocking aid, Netanyahu himself blocked aid to Gaza. The Guardian [reported in May](https://substack.com/redirect/b2efd7cf-e814-468e-a5a7-ba8f8162ff8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Those blocking the vehicles say the aid they carry is being diverted by Hamas instead of being delivered to civilians in need, a claim relief agencies reject. US officials have also said that _Israel has offered no evidence_ to support allegations that Hamas is diverting aid.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ccc02787-46bb-4fb3-a5e8-fb482db001f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Guardian furthermore reported that the Israeli military worked subversively to tip off extremist Israeli settlers to block and destroy aid to Gaza. Extremist Israeli settlers went as far as personally [stopping truck drivers and beating them](https://substack.com/redirect/3509f106-59a0-4446-bb32-76179432c7f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the mere allegation that they were delivering aid to Gaza. The Guardian reports:
> ...Israel's security forces are tipping off far-right activists and settlers to the location of aid trucks delivering vital supplies to Gaza, enabling the groups to block and vandalise the convoys, according to multiple sources [including] a spokesperson from the main Israeli activist group behind the blockades told the Guardian. The claim of collusion by members of the security forces is supported by messages from internal internet chat groups reviewed by the Guardian as well as accounts from a number of witnesses and human rights activists.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eBiuNSdF04Beo22ye_gWpZ6teN3Jj-skAIkTAK85y_0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149381270)
In short, Blinken saw the reports from Human Rights Watch, OxFam, The Guardian, and two U.S. Government agencies via their official reports--all in full agreement that the Israeli government is illegally blocking aid to Gaza as Palestinians starved to death--and decided to testify to the opposite effect to U.S. Congress.
There exist only two possibilities at this point:
* Either the people working at USAID who were responsible for investigating and reporting (apparently falsely) that Israel was illegally blocking aid to Palestine should be prosecuted for lying to the Federal Government.
* Or, Secretary Blinken should be prosecuted for lying to U.S. Congress in contravention to the factual USAID report, and then also prosecuted for illegally approving arms to Netanyahu in violation of the Leahy Laws.

There's no third possibility here. I find it impossible that the top two foremost authorities on humanitarian assistance in the US Government both lied to the Secretary of State on a matter as serious and grave as this. And given the lack of terminations or prosecution of those government employees, it appears Blinken also agrees that they did not lie. It therefore appears painfully undeniable that Blinken knowingly lied to U.S. Congress after receiving and rejecting the indisputable USAID reports that Israel is illegally blocking aid to Gaza.
It would be incredibly dangerous to let this massive injustice to go ignored, as doing so sets a horrifying precedence for future administrations. Indeed, if the Leahy Laws will not be enforced in this instance, what is to stop a future MAGA administration from illegally selling weapons to Viktor Orban, or Assad, or Kim Jong Un? And if you think this is a fantastical claim, remember that [Donald Trump forced the release of 5000 Taliban terrorists](https://substack.com/redirect/fa02a4ec-a639-4f39-953f-0d6d98ca9d22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for exactly nothing in return, and to this day we still don't know the true nature of his relationship with Putin? Holding Blinken accountable now is not just a matter of justice and principle, but of long term national security.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..eBiuNSdF04Beo22ye_gWpZ6teN3Jj-skAIkTAK85y_0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149381270)
Finally, remember that stopping arms to Netanyahu is not just the moral and legally smart decision, it is the politically smart decision. A recent national CBS/YouGov poll, reports [the following critical facts](https://substack.com/redirect/dd433361-8be6-4c7c-9e0c-ee575ea3d7ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about how united Americans are to end the siege on Gaza by withholding arms from Netanyahu:
* 61% of Americans oppose weapons to Israel's assault in Gaza
* 77% of Democrats reject US weapons to Israel

My fear is that the Biden administrations continued refusal to listen to the will of the American people hurts VP Harris's chances to win in November. In an election as tight as this election is shaping up to be, it is entirely meritless to enfroce a position that more than 3 in 5 Americans and nearly 4 in 5 Democrats oppose.
The bottom line is that Blinken absolutely knew that the Israeli government under Netanyahu was illegally blocking aid to Gaza--and knowing this--he testified to the opposite to US Congress. If, as Democrats rightly remind us regarding Donald Trump, that no one is above the law not even the President, then that principle must likewise and unquestionably apply to the Secretary of State.

But in February the Israeli government had prohibited the transfer of flour, that had been accused of having ties with Hamas. But we also know this is a lie from Netanyahu. While falsely accusing Hamas of blocking aid, Netanyahu himself blocked aid to Gaza. The Guardian : Those blocking the vehicles say the aid they carry is being diverted by Hamas instead of being delivered to civilians in need, a claim relief agencies reject. US officials have also said that Israel has offered no evidence to support allegations that Hamas is diverting aid. | | ---|---|--- The Guardian furthermore reported that the Israeli military worked subversively to tip off extremist Israeli settlers to block and destroy aid to Gaza. Extremist Israeli settlers went as far as personally on the mere allegation that they were delivering aid to Gaza. The Guardian reports: ...Israel's security forces are tipping off far-right activists and settlers to the location of aid trucks delivering vital supplies to Gaza, enabling the groups to block and vandalise the convoys, according to multiple sources [including] a spokesperson from the main Israeli activist group behind the blockades told the Guardian. The claim of collusion by members of the security forces is supported by messages from internal internet chat groups reviewed by the Guardian as well as accounts from a number of witnesses and human rights activists. In short, Blinken saw the reports from Human Rights Watch, OxFam, The Guardian, and two U.S. Government agencies via their official reports--all in full agreement that the Israeli government is illegally blocking aid to Gaza as Palestinians starved to death--and decided to testify to the opposite effect to U.S. Congress. There exist only two possibilities at this point: Either the people working at USAID who were responsible for investigating and reporting (apparently falsely) that Israel was illegally blocking aid to Palestine should be prosecuted for lying to the Federal Government. Or, Secretary Blinken should be prosecuted for lying to U.S. Congress in contravention to the factual USAID report, and then also prosecuted for illegally approving arms to Netanyahu in violation of the Leahy Laws. There's no third possibility here. I find it impossible that the top two foremost authorities on humanitarian assistance in the US Government both lied to the Secretary of State on a matter as serious and grave as this. And given the lack of terminations or prosecution of those government employees, it appears Blinken also agrees that they did not lie. It therefore appears painfully undeniable that Blinken knowingly lied to U.S. Congress after receiving and rejecting the indisputable USAID reports that Israel is illegally blocking aid to Gaza. It would be incredibly dangerous to let this massive injustice to go ignored, as doing so sets a horrifying precedence for future administrations. Indeed, if the Leahy Laws will not be enforced in this instance, what is to stop a future MAGA administration from illegally selling weapons to Viktor Orban, or Assad, or Kim Jong Un? And if you think this is a fantastical claim, remember that for exactly nothing in return, and to this day we still don't know the true nature of his relationship with Putin? Holding Blinken accountable now is not just a matter of justice and principle, but of long term national security. Finally, remember that stopping arms to Netanyahu is not just the moral and legally smart decision, it is the politically smart decision. A recent national CBS/YouGov poll, reports about how united Americans are to end the siege on Gaza by withholding arms from Netanyahu: 61% of Americans oppose weapons to Israel's assault in Gaza 77% of Democrats reject US weapons to Israel My fear is that the Biden administrations continued refusal to listen to the will of the American people hurts VP Harris's chances to win in November. In an election as tight as this election is shaping up to be, it is entirely meritless to enfroce a position that more than 3 in 5 Americans and nearly 4 in 5 Democrats oppose. The bottom line is that Blinken absolutely knew that the Israeli government under Netanyahu was illegally blocking aid to Gaza--and knowing this--he testified to the opposite to US Congress. If, as Democrats rightly remind us regarding Donald Trump, that no one is above the law not even the President, then that principle must likewise and unquestionably apply to the Secretary of State.
