Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

A few
years ago, New York magazine posed the question: "When Did
Everyone Become a Socialist?"

This is,
of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left
in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and
our way of life.

In a
recent issue of Imprimis-Hillsdale College's digest of
liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of
the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a
two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on
top and socialism for the majority below."

Today, as
a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand
the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism.

Your
input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight
for the future of liberty in our country.

Will you
please share your views on the political, social, and cultural
forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your
National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63580667:sRyyE7WNl:m:3:2532013465:DE38D06FC833BA05BF9F171EA4093E50:r

Do you
believe politicians who encourage young people to embrace
socialism are doing a disservice to the country?
YES
NO

Sadly,
socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the
young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...

. . .
during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those
16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also
increased in popularity among all ages.

Why is
this?

Draconian
government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated
competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream
come true for corporate socialists.

At the
same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what
socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures
wherever it has been tried.

This is a
result of the far-Left's "long march through the
institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools,
and the media.

Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once
confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race
theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as
school boards and even the military.

But it is
in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which
teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens
according to race-are most dangerous.

You may
recall that many young Americans with college degrees who
championed socialist policies participated in the riots and
violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.

In the
face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free
markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and
teach millions has never been more urgently needed.

That's
why I need your thoughts quickly.

By
responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five
days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent
rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach
increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope
to hear from friends representing every part of the country.

Education
is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your
partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.

As
Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure,
the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy."

If you
agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey
on Socialism today.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63580667:sRyyE7WNl:m:3:2532013465:DE38D06FC833BA05BF9F171EA4093E50:r

Despite
the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-it is
NEVER too late to defend liberty through education.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

---

| | Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol rotunda floor on January 6. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93534225/500814526/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-25-bluesuit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2837ebd8-487b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODM3ZWJkOC00ODdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sdfapl_yHXGB7HJru-ynCAN7qxxr1sYw6MlFIbVpFvE=) Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I'd never wear it again. **But the story of January 6 isn't just about violence, insurrection, and trauma.** Like our country's story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw. I still cherish every single one. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93534226/500814532/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-25-bluesuit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2837ebd8-487b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODM3ZWJkOC00ODdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sdfapl_yHXGB7HJru-ynCAN7qxxr1sYw6MlFIbVpFvE=) Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together. Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground. **That common ground is closer than you might realize.** I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in D.C., the in-fighting within the GOP's own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It's a mess, for sure – and it's all of ours to clean up together. clean_body: Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew not long after the 2020 election. | | | | Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol rotunda floor on January 6. = Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I'd never wear it again. But the story of January 6 isn't just about violence, insurrection, and trauma. Like our country's story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw. I still cherish every single one. = Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together. Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground. That common ground is closer than you might realize. I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in D.C., the in-fighting within the GOP's own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It's a mess, for sure – and it's all of ours to clean up together. = I'm raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. clean_body: I spent the day in Wisconsin with Eric Hovde, the man who will defeat Tammy Baldwin. | Fellow Conservative, it's Senator John Thune from South Dakota. As Minority Whip, it’s a top priority to help Republicans win a new majority in the Senate. That’s why I went to Wisconsin to campaign with my friend, Eric Hovde - our best hope at defeating one of Kamala Harris’s closest allies. After spending the day there, I know we can defeat Tammy Baldwin. Wisconsin voters are ready for change, but the Left is pouring liberal dollars into the state. We have a winning message, but if voters don’t hear it, we will lose on November 5th. Eric Hovde is being outspent by tens of millions of dollars. Despite the onslaught, he's only down one point, within the margin of error. Can you imagine what we could do if we were able to bridge this fundraising and spending gap? | If you agree with Eric’s vision for America (I bet you will), I hope I can count on you to step up. Thank you, John Thune | MEET ERIC Eric's a fourth-generation Wisconsinite, born and raised in the Madison area. He's a serial entrepreneur. He founded and managed his first business in his twenties and then went on to start and build many others. When he is not running his businesses, he is focused on his family and his philanthropic endeavors. He and his brother Steve operate 10 Hovde Homes around the world that provide shelter, supportive services and love to vulnerable children. Join the Conversation: | Paid for by Hovde for Wisconsin

Hi Derek —
This is Eve, Adam’s wife (yes, I know, Adam and Eve...). I hope you and your
family are doing well.

As we’re in the full swing of election season, I have been spending a lot
of time with Adam on the campaign trail, traveling up and down the Golden
State.

Getting to meet so many incredible people across California has been an
honor. This is Adam’s first statewide race, and he’s meeting so many new
voters for the very first time.

As always, when Adam meets people on the campaign trail, he asks, “How can
I help? What can I do to make a difference for your family?” He really
listens and cares deeply — even if it makes us terribly late for our next
meeting or dinner event.

Hearing Californians’ stories, learning the challenges people are facing,
and working to find solutions to ease people’s burdens is what drives Adam
in his work. It’s what motivated him to run for office in the first place
(and reminder, he lost the first two times he ran for office), and it’s
what motivates him today.

That’s the Adam I know and love. And the Adam I’ve been so happy to share
with his constituents all these years.

Adam and I on the campaign trail a LONG time ago...

Adam is so deeply committed to our state. No one works harder than him. He
is always up late and up early reading up on the issues, making calls,
meeting with constituents, and traveling back and forth across our state
and back to Washington, DC.

I’m so proud of Adam, and with less than 45 days until the election, I am
humbly asking you,

body:

---
| |

| Good morning Friend,

**Young Americans need to appreciate what makes America so exceptional. **

MCPP is delighted to offer a two part course for high school students that aims to do precisely that!

**Our Mississippi Leadership Academy program for 2024 is specifically designed for high school students. **Do you have children or grandchildren that would benefit by taking part?

The two part program takes place in Jackson on Saturday October 12th and Saturday November 9th.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=0c1544fa9c&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click above to learn more information and apply!_
| Leading academics and state leaders will be speaking and include Attorney General Lynn Fitch, State Auditor Shad White, Starla Brown from Americans for Prosperity, Forest Thigpen from Empower, and Douglas Carswell from MCPP.

The Mississippi Leadership Academy offers an incredible opportunity to engage with thought leaders and develop leadership skills.

There is no charge for taking part, and those that graduate will be given a Certificate and Letter of Recommendation. In previous years, several of our graduates from the program have interned with state leaders.

Because we are a non-profit, students that participate are eligible to receive volunteer hours, but have to be present at both sessions to receive credit!
---
|
---
We are committed to empowering future leaders who are ready to step up, engage, and lead with integrity. If you or someone you know is interested in shaping the future of our state, we encourage you to apply or share this information with others.

Together, we can strengthen the future of Mississippi through principled leadership!

body:
Great News! After receiving thousands of petitions, Governor Newsom signed AB 2655 and AB 2839 to ban deepfakes of candidates, elected officials, and elections officials in political advertising or other election communications that are reasonably likely to harm the reputation of candidates or undermine confidence in the outcome of the election for 120 days before an election or 60 days after.
But this is just a stepping stone -- we need to take California's success and make it a reality in other states . That means we need everyone's help to send messages to their governors too.
Add your name to demand your state bans AI deepfakes in our elections >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092524_1&amount=25]
Folks, The danger is on the horizon:
Fake video, images, and audio — so-called “deepfakes” created by artificial intelligence (AI) — are becoming a major problem for elections around the world.
Just last month, Elon Musk shared a deepfake video of Kamala Harris in which a hyper-realistic but fake version of the Vice President degrades herself and calls herself a “deep state puppet.” Sadly, it was viewed more than 150 million times in a single week.
California has the opportunity to lead the nation against such deepfake manipulation of our elections by passing two groundbreaking bills . We need to let Gov. Newsom know that we need these passed.
Sign our petition now: Let Governor Gavin Newsom know the nation is watching and he needs to sign these now! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Need to know more about these bills? Here they are:
AB 2839 will ban deepfakes of candidates, elected officials, and elections officials in political advertising or other election communications that are reasonably likely to harm the reputation of candidates or undermine confidence in the outcome of the election for 120 days before an election and for 60 days after.
AB 2655 will require large online platforms to block or label such deepfakes when they get complaints about demonstrably untrue and provably false content meant to impermissibly influence our elections at peak election times.
We need to get these bills over the finish line so the rest of the country knows we're not going to stand for this kind of interference in our elections.
Add your name today: Tell Gavin Newsom to sign both AB 2655 and AB 2839 right away! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

**[It’s simple: If Republicans win Montana, we win back control of the Senate.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b6cb8f39caa94afaa00a557a2ac55599&_e=xEU8T-O3P70jsaqUCRWyQBPG0peC4mHXFeH9KZxRWEznHGOnsQtf-PRu2UVYOO4Re-7-dfGHY6GMeSATB6S3omurnUXniF0nyARtBVuz11l7fORCjuYIFs4-E7ILsL26teJEEJh_YHMxjxCKxWKSnyPJBiIjWM52sjUNHuSwZjrCvY8wMa993PXQzthSB8DVfD5KQcjv_x6IGt_4QJ4KlnPVnZsVaz7vi_fV-65nGuGSZ9QIPw8ZzK-6EJUIu2weZIbw7NRS7fnO00w-jQx4JvnDk2OKIeGISuf57kKPMg-5NqXIkxpf4Tox3eFngaTNmTWXEwtUJ23xeXqSE7qJZwC8jp2tWBDAf6yFgVUuRzxRP3dr4CNrPugEKsMqdd9Ma6RrFU_QlLs_E8McBiqiD0JkBryyHoTw8CWGedO6peE%3D) **

**Chuck Schumer and Kamala Harris know that if Jon Tester goes down, they have no hope of killing the filibuster and enacting sweeping changes to our republic, like packing the Supreme Court and making Washington D.C. a state.**

**[A donation to my campaign today](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b6cb8f39caa94afaa00a557a2ac55599&_e=xEU8T-O3P70jsaqUCRWyQBPG0peC4mHXFeH9KZxRWEznHGOnsQtf-PRu2UVYOO4Re-7-dfGHY6GMeSATB6S3omurnUXniF0nyARtBVuz11l7fORCjuYIFs4-E7ILsL26teJEEJh_YHMxjxCKxWKSnyPJBiIjWM52sjUNHuSwZjrCvY8wMa993PXQzthSB8DVfD5KQcjv_x6IGt_4QJ4KlnPVnZsVaz7vi_fV-65nGuGSZ9QIPw8ZzK-6EJUIu2weZIbw7NRS7fnO00w-jQx4JoGTdE7lcL8urzj_SQLpi8oCNOyGp9JFrdwtn7fl7ySI7gnHPqMb6CdBI1pSciKUxJUiVqIpcfPEbFWzgtCphn9j8mBV2leK2qLg2wMlO9s3bYPCjayRS6M_All5C2Ki92EAEg0HEvzcgdZonBOdE80%3D)** is not only a donation to help elect me to the U.S. Senate; it’s an investment in the future of our American institutions.

To stop Democrats from doing their worst, we must act before it’s too late.

**[If everyone reading this email contributed just $10](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b6cb8f39caa94afaa00a557a2ac55599&_e=xEU8T-O3P70jsaqUCRWyQBPG0peC4mHXFeH9KZxRWEznHGOnsQtf-PRu2UVYOO4Re-7-dfGHY6GMeSATB6S3omurnUXniF0nyARtBVuz11l7fORCjuYIFs4-E7ILsL26teJEEJh_YHMxjxCKxWKSnyPJBiIjWM52sjUNHuSwZjrCvY8wMa993PXQzthSB8DVfD5KQcjv_x6IGt_4QJ4KlnPVnZsVaz7vi_fV-65nGuGSZ9QIPw8ZzK-6EJUIu2weZIbw7NRS7fnO00w-jQx4Jgbqmt0Hr8e8_r-itHhLRq-xJaait7tzrnt0i8anshxGMCR25K_sgMpwXJbxj3DRYIJ023ssgz4duFFMoRFdjifnTntdaAzAjsusu-8cg2dZN2q0e8PmKUeePZOX0-PkS6z6omEJQRpl2UrEKY4cCw0%3D)** , we’d raise over $2,000,000. Peter, Election Day is quickly approaching, but now is the time for you to make your plan to vote. Many states have voter registration deadlines in the next couple of weeks. **If you are not registered to vote, please take immediate action to get registered in your state**. Different states have different laws, so I'd recommend that you visit [Vote.gov](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=dcdf9267391447a785665e3451375d34&_e=QybRTOIThEqENWF9URBN5tkWoIBzj0BRZTHOiNpPE-HgfXvaHlVlNxboXPE9baog_TvObJq2UN8lB0hcY3Uh2nDAu6k8_SoUyavlAj1rbDchOommXAcD1dz7qv2f65AvAPE2IrgfDqSw2VF0dXNJ8KOLwMhI1IWZB6IXhKGf4t1LsSayyOF3KAxv8ynadEBa) to get the process started.
---
[GET STARTED HERE](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=dcdf9267391447a785665e3451375d34&_e=QybRTOIThEqENWF9URBN5tkWoIBzj0BRZTHOiNpPE-FMfA46OlCCYy3Ynx6S4GXggeXbb8wwHUtk3HyE_fWJsM7zjrjtwAeivVVRIhCA8yh3-xEeRcZEoYIE4X-R6MozFza6cwWjieuHtCosGOLwEHIAKBqutft5XtTPexPoUj9B_Cvx6ZedgqZeuWT5EfH1)
---
**If you are already registered but need to update your registration because of an address change or other circumstance** , do an online search for your state's election authority to learn more. For example, here in Ohio, the Ohio Secretary of State's website can help get you connected with your county board of elections to update your registration. Many states also allow for early in-person voting or absentee (mail) voting. I'd encourage you to take advantage of these opportunities to avoid the long lines that are expected on Election Day. Despite what you may be hearing from the political candidates this year, in America, we make it very easy to vote and very hard to cheat. When there have been irregularities in the past, they are quickly caught by states and investigated. In the majority of instances, they were simple mistakes made, not intentional efforts to break the law. We can all rest assured that regardless of where you live in our country, your vote will count and there will not be widespread cheating. Don't miss your chance to vote in this year's election! Check your registration today.
---
I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

Our FINAL FEC end-of-quarter deadline is coming up in just a few days, and I want to make sure you know why this goal is so important. End-of-quarter deadlines are the BIGGEST markers of where our campaign stands against Tim Kaine. They’re when we release our numbers for all of our Commonwealth to see, and if we come up short, people could lose confidence in our mission. Hung and our team are strong - now, we need the numbers to back it up. This is our last chance to show Virginia that we have the juice to beat Tim Kaine. Peter,

We hate to be so direct, but after our late primary we started the general election at a fairly significant financial disadvantage to our extremist opponent, and we need a boost before the weekend to keep pace for our fundraising goal.

Here are two reasons why hitting this mark is so important:
* **This is a campaign about putting people first.** Rebecca is running on values we can all get behind—decent wages for hard work, keeping our middle class employed, access to affordable healthcare and providing our parents the resources to age with dignity.

* **The House majority runs through Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District.** And together, we have a real chance to defeat Derrick Van Orden and flip Wisconsin’s 3rd.

But for all the people behind our movement, we need to keep pace with Van Orden’s dark money warchest, and we're doing it with $3 grassroots donations. A lot of them.

On September 13, [the Detroit Metro Times ran a story](https://substack.com/redirect/bee5a5bc-2d9c-4ea8-8afd-1be486886da4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) based on an interview with Rashida Tlaib in which she denounced the filing of felony charges against pro-Palestinian protesters by Michigan AG Dana Nessel. Almost two weeks later, what she didn't actually say in that interview - but was accused of saying anyway - remains a national story. ([Short version of all this is here](https://substack.com/redirect/4f67f4b6-d3ae-4da2-a547-7711236d055d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
She argued that Nessel was applying the law inconsistently, because demonstrably more violent demonstrations on other issues had not drawn charges from the AG. "We've had the right to dissent, the right to protest," Tlaib said. "We've done it for climate, the immigrant rights movement, for Black lives, and even around issues of injustice among water shutoffs. But it seems that the attorney general decided if the issue was Palestine, she was going to treat it differently, and that alone speaks volumes about possible biases within the agency she runs."
She then explicitly named the source of that bias as pressure from the University of Michigan leadership. "I think people at the University of Michigan put pressure on her to do this, and she fell for it," Tlaib said. "I think President Ono and Board of Regent members were very much heavy-handed in this. It had to come from somewhere."
She went on to say that a decade from now, the public would understand that the university had pushed for these unfair charges. "In 10 years, the University of Michigan itself is going to teach about this movement and say how wonderful it was, or how it moved our country toward a direction that it needed to, following international law and human rights laws and our own U.S. laws," Tlaib said. "Yet people are going to write about how the University of Michigan decided to prosecute, criminalize, and vilify their students when they just did everything that they were taught to do."
Now, you might disagree with that assessment from Tlaib. You might think the charges were fair, and the just consequences of the protesters' actions. You might think Nessel wasn't actually swayed by the university leadership's pressure and would have charged them regardless, and perhaps there are distinctions we don't understand between these protests and the more violent ones where she didn't level charges. All of that is fair game to ponder.
Yet what you can't find anywhere in Tlaib's comments is the thing she is now being accused of by CNN; Josh Kraushaar, the editor in chief of Jewish Insider; the Anti-Defamation League; and more than a dozen House Democrats. As Kraushaar wrote in JI: "Tlaib has also claimed that Nessel is only charging the protesters because she's Jewish." That was an assertion repeated by Dana Bash and Jake Tapper at CNN and by Jonathan Greenblatt at the ADL. The Metro Times reporter quickly went public to correct the record. In response, Bash, Tapper, and Greenblatt variously said they needed to clarify their comments. Kraushaar edited his story to take out "claimed" and replace it with "suggested," which - as you can read above in her comments - is still not true. All of them are standing by the thrust of their remarks, saying that Tlaib's comments are vague enough that antisemitism can be read into them. Bash and Kraushaar said they had not heard back from Tlaib's office when they asked her to clarify the remarks. But it appears none of them read the interview. She is clear about where the bias is coming from in this case: the University of Michigan.
It's been startling to see this five-day news cycle unfold based on a total fabrication or, at best, a refusal to read the entire article from September 13.
There's a [petition going around urging ](https://substack.com/redirect/4f67f4b6-d3ae-4da2-a547-7711236d055d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)CNN and Kraushaar to issue a correction and apologize and I think with enough pressure they might do it._**[](https://substack.com/redirect/4f67f4b6-d3ae-4da2-a547-7711236d055d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
_**[If you can sign it, please do that here. ](https://substack.com/redirect/4f67f4b6-d3ae-4da2-a547-7711236d055d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
Now, why did we start talking about this issue on September 20 when the article was published a week earlier? Well, on September 20, [National Review ran a cartoon](https://substack.com/redirect/cfd7a4b1-ebcf-4cf1-a0f6-cb774e5aca69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) depicting Rashida Tlaib as a Hezbollah operative with a pager exploding on her desk. It was on that day that Nessel decided to launch her attack. "Rashida's religion should not be used in a cartoon to imply that she's a terrorist. It's Islamophobic and wrong," [she tweeted. ](https://substack.com/redirect/6d9336a3-f19c-47b8-9f47-c47a4b81f692?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"Just as Rashida should not use my religion to imply I cannot perform my job fairly as Attorney General. It's anti-Semitic and wrong."
Actually, it's just plain wrong. It never happened.
_We covered the story on Counter Points today,[ link to the show is here](https://substack.com/redirect/bb4fef81-eb73-42e2-9b5b-5d37fe05eef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Tlaib segment starts at the 26:30 mark._

| Chris Lauzon joins the MassGOP in Condemning Senator Julian Cyr's Silence on Arrest of Violent Offenders in Nantucket Amid ICE Operations
---
---
| Barnstable, MA- This month, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents have been active on Nantucket, arresting five illegal immigrants classified as "violent offenders" for committing sex crimes against minors. These heinous acts are both appalling and shameful. These individuals should never have been in the United States in the first place, and the incidents themselves are a direct consequence to our broken immigration system. Members of this tight-knit community are terrified that these individuals were walking freely among them. Notably silent is State Senator Julian Cyr, who has yet to make a single statement regarding the arrests in the very community he represents.
Chris Lauzon, candidate for State Senate for the Cape and Islands, provided comment on the arrests and the deafening silence of Senator Cyr stating, "It is outrageous that individuals in the country illegally at the time of their arrests were not immediately handed over to ICE but were instead allowed to post bail and return to our communities. I cannot fathom why any court would ignore ICE detainers for those who have committed such heinous crimes. The Democratic supermajority's failure to protect our communities is inexcusable."
"Senator Cyr's silence in the face of this crisis highlights a staggering lack of leadership on Beacon Hill--he refuses to even acknowledge the problem. As the next State Senator for the Cape and Islands, I will fight for policies designed to protect our communities," Lauzon concluded.
###

Chris Lauzon, candidate for State Senate for the Cape and Islands, provided comment on the arrests and the deafening silence of Senator Cyr stating, "It is outrageous that individuals in the country illegally at the time of their arrests were not immediately handed over to ICE but were instead allowed to post bail and return to our communities. I cannot fathom why any court would ignore ICE detainers for those who have committed such heinous crimes. The Democratic supermajority's failure to protect our communities is inexcusable." "Senator Cyr's silence in the face of this crisis highlights a staggering lack of leadership on Beacon Hill--he refuses to even acknowledge the problem. As the next State Senator for the Cape and Islands, I will fight for policies designed to protect our communities," Lauzon concluded. | | == | MassGOP | == | == == | | | | Massachusetts Republican Party | 85 Merrimac Street, Suite 400 | Boston, MA 02114 US | | | | | | |

Today I received the state of Florida's formal dismissal of its retaliatory case against me stemming from the December 2020 armed raid of my home.
The relief my family and I feel today cannot be captured in words.
That I managed to escape Florida with no criminal convictions, having not been forced to plead guilty to anything, is owed entirely to the public support you have given me all these years.
Closing this chapter of my life represents the end of 3 years, 9 months and 7 days of living under the state's surveillance, under constant threat of further persecution and retaliation.
I am profoundly grateful for the love and warmth you all have shown me.
You all helped me take on a tyrant.
I hope you'll continue with me on this journey of defeating tyrants wherever they may be.

---

Fellow American,

**This is how stupid they think we are. Soon they will say this is a deepfake. Obama sounded like he was America-First, until he was elected.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=361cc0161263411381e12882f5841787&_e=IV5f9lmkESg-QVOVp2VIvy-oXLf0nehgApHsYNFQKM_fphVyhMih9UvqFmuepHDUgUIAi3jn5LneBNIgfZFiPx0-3hwVIAk_oE4S4hnlZXUGll1XUVtLoHALiqLQgEmmrucze33WAPjCan0AMsqBUxJUSEddE6upCWY4oebwmtx_C-M-q8hhSKWUFXN7UgXgQyXPC0C-3jlP4MmpCOKdsNIt_P51TzUxY4EzygVZLPJ1RnUZqfrCJqZAXDHvKNI0uiRTunx7eoGdU5ni3JAFNfG37Ykve68UKCbmVtmjn5IR7J-mgwPAEoKqwTJT-AQ5Kpi9o3RGzGPNaFMl9NS0sw%3D%3D)
In this video, Obama sounded like a lot of America-First Republicans in 2024 on securing the border and making sure the immigrants are coming through legally. That all changed once he deceived the voters and became President. Now, we have over 11 Million Illegal Immigrants that invaded our country over the past four years.

Kamala is running with the same playbook about the 2nd Amendment and everything else. She’s saying the things that undecided voters want to hear, but she’ll revert back to Radical Left Factory Settings as soon as she wins.

**_They’re just lying to us and the liberal media is running with it._**

To make matters worse, the Democrats currently have the Majority in the Senate. That means that regardless of who wins the Presidential Election, Senate Democrats will make sure that only their Radical Leftist policies get passed.

That’s why I’m running against Obama’s ally, Amy Klobuchar. I’m sick and tired of being lied to, so I’m standing up and doing something about it.

If I can beat Klobuchar, Republicans have a great chance at flipping the Senate and making sure that we return to common sense policy on the border, world peace, and rebounding the economy.

**But, my final End-of-Quarter deadline is here, and I’m way behind my fundraising projections.**

When the FEC releases my numbers to the public, everyone will see how much momentum we really have. If we don’t hit my goal, it could be the final nail in the coffin.

**This EOQ Deadline is the most important deadline of the year.**

[**I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $20 or more to help me Flip the Senate and Save this Country.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=361cc0161263411381e12882f5841787&_e=IV5f9lmkESg-QVOVp2VIvy-oXLf0nehgApHsYNFQKM_fphVyhMih9UvqFmuepHDUgUIAi3jn5LneBNIgfZFiPx0-3hwVIAk_oE4S4hnlZXUGll1XUVtLoHALiqLQgEmmrucze33WAPjCan0AMsqBUxJUSEddE6upCWY4oebwmtx_C-M-q8hhSKWUFXN7UgXg6Fme7zTDtr740JjLS3FJtHwUbAoinKJ4srfyyf7WBC_kQSw_7CiIzRs2a9RMYXGqQQ_SG2_tJF5fSCNEQHveIyTMGZFImQJo_tsx97-3EZfN9pHoFGoAEDqxyuDa7OIsSzPBNlcKU1bo3JaV2ItBig%3D%3D)

Pramila relies on small-dollar donations from our grassroots supporters.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240925-4329-footer&t=1&akid=4329%2E420207%2EwZFTve)
We noticed a concerning trend in our online fundraising, Peter.
Pramila relies on small-dollar donations from our grassroots supporters. She doesn’t take a dime from the corporate PACs that have massive influence in Congress. **So, it’s significant that we’ve seen a decrease in online fundraising this month.**
During a presidential election year when Pramila is running for re-election and we’re fighting to retake the Democratic majority in the House, we cannot see our fundraising numbers continue to drop. [**Can you donate $3 today to help us turn our fundraising around?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240925-1?refcode=em20240925-1&amount=3&refcode2=4329_420207_wZFTve&akid=4329%2E420207%2EwZFTve)
Here’s what’s on the line:
Over the last few months, our campaign has provided field organizing, phone banking, and fundraising support for people-first progressives and Democrats running in tough swing district races against Republicans. Pramila has traveled to be on the ground to knock doors and build support for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats in states across the country.
That all costs money. It’s work we can only sustain with your support.
Pramila is also facing her own re-election race. We’re organizing across our district, formulating GOTV plans, and talking to voters about Pramila’s work. As we ramp up ahead of Election Day, we’re going to need a wave of grassroots support.

MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY AGAIN

It’s Time to Fight Back
Dear Peter,
In 2004, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. was the darling of liberals and the Democratic Party establishment, an environmentalist unafraid to take on the biggest and most powerful polluters in America.
But over time, the Democrats began to abandon the ideals he believed in—peace, freedom of speech, honest government, and standing up for the working class. At first, the rank and file didn’t see it.
[**But as the years passed, the DNC became a tool of big money, the war machine, and the very corporations Kennedy had spent his career fighting.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=still_fighting_9_25_24_rnd1&n=5)
Then Kennedy took up a new cause—children’s health and chronic disease. It was a natural evolution, because the same toxic substances—and the same corporations—that pollute our rivers, soil, and wildlife also poison human health.
**As a result, RFK Jr. became a pariah.** The liberal establishment turned its back on him. The media tried to silence him. And the Biden-Harris administration pressured social media to censor him.
Both Democrats and Republicans ignored the crisis of chronic disease and children’s health.
**But not anymore.**
America is waking up to the greatest crisis of our generation.
How can a nation be healthy if its people are not healthy?
The regulatory agencies have turned a blind eye to this, controlled by big money interests that profit from a sick care model. _Meanwhile, Big Pharma offers nothing but more pills._
They tried to convince you it wasn’t happening.
They told us poison was food, and real food was poison..
They said poison was medicine, and medicine was poison.
They told us lies were true, and that truth was lies.
[They silenced the voices that spoke out about the assault on children’s health. They silenced Kennedy’s voice. **They silenced YOUR voice.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=still_fighting_9_25_24_rnd1&n=6)
**But they can’t get away with it anymore!**
A whole political movement has risen to fight back, because we know that we can’t make America great again unless we make America healthy again.
[Now is your chance to join this fight.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=still_fighting_9_25_24_rnd1&n=7) Stand with Kennedy and support the movement for a healthier, freer future. _Will help us take on the forces that profit from sickness and deception?_

Together, we can restore truth, health, and freedom to America!
Team Kennedy

---
Fellow Conservative, it's Senator John Thune from South Dakota.

As Minority Whip, it’s a top priority to help Republicans win a new majority in the Senate.

That’s why I went to Wisconsin to campaign with my friend, Eric Hovde - our best hope at defeating one of Kamala Harris’s closest allies.

After spending the day there, I know we can defeat Tammy Baldwin. Wisconsin voters are ready for change, but the Left is pouring liberal dollars into the state. We have a winning message, but if voters don’t hear it, we will lose on November 5th. Eric Hovde is being outspent by tens of millions of dollars.

name: Senate Conservatives
subject: Dems Seeks to Save Vulnerable Senators
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SENATE CONSERVATIVES ACTION AND NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
Increase election integrity so every lawful vote is counted. | | |
---
The main reason Democrats pushed Joe Biden out of the race for president was not to win the White House. **It was actually done to save vulnerable Democrats running down the ballot.** The thinking was that even if Kamala Harris or another replacement could not defeat Donald Trump, they could at least make it close enough to save Democrats like **Jon Tester** in Montana, **Sherrod Brown** in Ohio, **Tammy Baldwin** in Wisconsin, and **Jacky Rosen** in Nevada. # Senator Jon Ossoff Endorses Patti Hewitt!
_U.S. Senator Jon Ossoff has formally endorsed Patti Hewitt in her campaign for Georgia’s 1st Congressional District_
---
| Peter,

We are thrilled to announce that [**U.S. Senator Jon Ossoff**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=65fdb74d08&e=0f456155ff) has officially endorsed Patti Hewitt in her race for Georgia’s 1st Congressional District!

As someone who knows what it takes to defeat tough Republican incumbents, Senator Ossoff’s endorsement is a powerful signal that Patti has the momentum to WIN in November! Here’s what Senator Ossoff had to say:

_“Coastal Georgia deserves a voice in U.S. Congress that is committed to improving access to healthcare and expanding economic opportunities. Patti Hewitt will be that voice.”

— Senator Jon Ossoff_

This endorsement is not only a huge vote of confidence in Patti’s leadership but also a signal to all of Coastal Georgia that **we have the momentum to WIN in November!

Why This Matters:

**Senator Ossoff knows firsthand that every vote—and every dollar—counts in tight races like ours. With **only four seats needed to flip the House** , Patti’s leadership will be key to ensuring Coastal Georgia finally gets the resources and attention it deserves.

**Our Time is NOW!

** This endorsement gives us incredible momentum, but we need your help to keep it going. The end of the quarter is fast approaching, and we have a big goal to hit **before September 30th**. Every contribution between now and the end of the month will help us fund critical outreach and voter mobilization efforts across the district.

**Will you chip in $50, $100, or whatever you can to help us reach our goal and fuel Patti’s fight to bring real change to Coastal Georgia?**

Let’s do this!

P.S. - Want to help spread the word about this exciting endorsement? Share it with your friends and neighbors or follow us on social media to stay in the loop!

# Natural Gas, Helium and Technology.
As a U.S. Congress Candidate from NM District 3, I know that New Mexico has all the resources to be successful, and most importantly, I know New Mexicans can benefit from these resources. Here are the puzzle pieces to create more jobs.
New Mexico is more than just a state that produces oil. New Mexico is also rich in the noble gas we know as helium.
* Helium is becoming more and more crucial in the production of microchips. Helium demand is expected to double by 2035. This is due to the high demand of semiconductors.
* Helium is used in other industries such as aerospace and the medical field.

Investing and utilizing our resources will keep United States energy independent and it will insure that we are also technologically independent.

---

[**We’ll share that list with you in a moment, but before we do, can you please contribute $25 or more now so our swing state newsrooms have the resources they need to combat right-wing misinformation in the final weeks of the election?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93562281/500883854/-593472309?refcode=20240925-EM-RightWingHoaxes&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWFmMjBiMGUtNjg3Yi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BCXuhTej-0WNGeFBIe3bocNi-To3mW_2Hoi95vMe14A=)
Ok, buckle up! And yes, these are all real!
* **Immigrants in Springfield, Ohio are eating pets:** Trump and JD Vance have repeatedly claimed that Haitian immigrants are eating pets in Springfield. The city manager and local law enforcement officials have repeatedly debunked the claim.
* **Kamala Harris was wearing an earpiece during the debate:** In fact, they were her Tiffany earrings that she had worn on multiple occasions.
* **Kamala Harris is not really a Black woman and a “DEI hire”:** As the former California AG, Senator, and current Vice President said, the racist lies are from Trump’s “same old tired playbook.”
* **Harris is ineligible to run for President:** Donald Trump and right-wing media have suggested that Harris might be ineligible because her parents weren’t U.S. citizens. She was born in California.
* **Harris is using AI-manipulation to inflate the size of her rally crowds:** Trump, emasculated by the size of his own crowds, claimed Harris is using AI to make it seem like her crowds are bigger than his. The photo Trump cited as evidence was taken by a Harris campaign staffer and is unaltered.
* **Harris is using a Nazi slogan as a part of her campaign:** Harris' campaign theme of “joy” was falsely linked to a Nazi-era slogan “Strength through Joy.” Harris and her campaign have never used the slogan.
* **Harris had the questions to the ABC debate leaked to her:** A supposed “whistleblower” claimed Harris received the debate questions in advance. ABC confirmed no questions were shared beforehand, and anyone who watched the debate can confirm that Harris boat raced Trump for 90 minutes straight.
* **Biden "sold state secrets":** A joke made by President Biden was edited to make it seem like he admitted to selling state secrets, omitting the follow-up line that made it clear he was kidding.
* **Joe Biden dropped out because a Democratic assassination attempt on Trump failed:** Trump ally and travel companion Laura Loomer spread this dangerous conspiracy on social media without evidence or consequence.
* **Biden is missing, and he may have died:** Laura Loomer said that “preparations” were being made for Biden’s memorial, even though he’s been regularly attending public events and campaigning for Harris. Biden is very alive and doing daily public events.

Navigating Colorado’s legislative landscape at the Club 20 debates
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
I've been getting very passionate about the health movement happening alongside RFK Jr. and Trump, and wanted to share [this article](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) I wrote about it last week. I've also been talking about it quite a bit on my [X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Come follow along and share your thoughts!
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, September 25, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Navigating Colorado’s legislative landscape at the Club 20 debates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
As Colorado elections draw near, the Club 20 debates offer a glimpse of the possible representation from which to choose in the state legislature.
With Democrats holding a supermajority in the House (46-19) and a near supermajority in the Senate (23-12), the Club 20 debates last week were crucial for voters who want their interests represented.
Water rights, agriculture, the housing crisis and healthcare were key issues dominating the discussion, as rural and urban Colorado face differing challenges. Where common ground can be agreed upon is a task often left to state lawmakers to tackle.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Border patrol: Kids as young as 8 are drugged, trafficked into the U.S. by smugglers posing as parents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Children as young as eight are being drugged and smuggled into the U.S. by traffickers posing as their parents, with Border Patrol rescuing victims in recent instances.
* Traffickers use fake family units to "recycle" children across the border, and officials have found traffickers with multiple children's birth certificates to support their false claims.
* One notable case involved a woman caught with two drugged children who were not related to her; she initially claimed a family connection, which was disproven during questioning.
* Authorities are concerned about the fate of trafficked children, who are at risk of further exploitation for labor or sex trafficking once in the U.S.
* Despite efforts to address these issues, the increasing number of unaccompanied migrant children and those unaccounted for after being released to sponsors in the U.S. continues to present significant challenges.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Majority of Democrats vote against bill that would deport sex offenders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY CALLER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. House passed a bill to deport and make inadmissible those convicted of sex offenses or domestic violence, with 158 Democrats voting against it.
* The bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to expand grounds for deportation and inadmissibility to include a variety of sex crimes and domestic violence offenses.
* Opponents of the bill, primarily Democrats, expressed concerns about its implications during an election year and questioned its necessity, arguing it could harm victims.
* ICE officials continue to arrest and deport sex offenders across the U.S., citing public safety and the need to remove threats from communities.
* Supporters of the bill argue that its passage is essential for protecting Americans and migrants from violent criminals, with ICE emphasizing their ongoing efforts to prioritize public safety by removing dangerous offenders.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[How NYC ‘sanctuary’ status allows bloodthirsty migrant gang Tren de Aragua to thrive in Big Apple’s shelters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* New York City's "sanctuary city" status has allowed the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua to exploit the local migrant shelter system by conducting illegal activities such as trafficking drugs, guns, and women.
* The city's policies prevent the NYPD from effectively policing these shelters and restrict communication with federal immigration agents, allowing dangerous criminals to be released back into communities rather than being deported.
* Despite the NYPD's efforts, their operations are often thwarted by internal tip-offs and stringent restrictions on police access to shelters, only allowing entry in cases of emergencies or with a warrant.
* Critics argue that the city administration should pursue more aggressive measures, including an executive order, to mitigate the negative impacts of the sanctuary city status on law enforcement capabilities.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver voters to decide on animal welfare, sales tax and union rights in November](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver voters will decide on twelve initiatives in November, including measures to increase sales tax for Denver Health and affordable housing, ban fur products, prohibit slaughterhouses, and expand union bargaining rights.
* Significant campaign spending, over $22 million, has been reported, with the largest expenditures on initiatives for Denver Health funding and the affordable housing tax increase.
* The fur product ban, proposed by Pro-Animal Future, faces opposition from groups like Hands Off My Hat, citing negative impacts on agriculture and the Denver Stock Show.
* The slaughterhouse ban initiative could lead to significant job losses and economic impacts, with substantial funding from both supporters and opponents.
* Question 2U aims to expand collective bargaining rights to all city employees, drawing considerable financial support from labor organizations, with no reported opposition funding.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Pueblo City Council meets for proposed abortion ordinance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 21 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Pueblo City Council held a meeting to discuss a proposed ordinance to ban abortion centers, coinciding with a heated debate on Amendment 79, which aims to establish abortion rights in Colorado and allow public funding for abortions.
* During the council meeting, arguments were presented about the impact of the Colorado Reproductive Health Equity Act (RHEA) on local governance, with proponents highlighting that it prohibits local government interference with abortion rights.
* The meeting addressed concerns from local council members about maintaining community standards and local control over abortion legislation, with further discussions and city council meetings planned to explore the possibility of local regulations in response to state laws.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[‘It does not bring back our loved ones’: Family members of King Soopers shooting victims react](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS 11 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Ahmad Alissa was sentenced to 10 life sentences plus 1,300 years for the mass shooting at a Colorado King Soopers, where he killed 10 people.
* Victims' families expressed mixed feelings during the sentencing; they acknowledged the justice served but noted the irreplaceable loss of their loved ones. Family members shared poignant impact statements in court, detailing the profound and lasting impact of the tragedy on their lives.
* A memorial at the King Soopers honors the victims, serving as a site of remembrance and reflection for the community.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Authorities are concerned about the fate of trafficked children, who are at risk of further exploitation for labor or sex trafficking once in the U.S. Despite efforts to address these issues, the increasing number of unaccompanied migrant children and those unaccounted for after being released to sponsors in the U.S. continues to present significant challenges. | The U.S. House passed a bill to deport and make inadmissible those convicted of sex offenses or domestic violence, with 158 Democrats voting against it. The bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to expand grounds for deportation and inadmissibility to include a variety of sex crimes and domestic violence offenses. Opponents of the bill, primarily Democrats, expressed concerns about its implications during an election year and questioned its necessity, arguing it could harm victims. ICE officials continue to arrest and deport sex offenders across the U.S., citing public safety and the need to remove threats from communities. Supporters of the bill argue that its passage is essential for protecting Americans and migrants from violent criminals, with ICE emphasizing their ongoing efforts to prioritize public safety by removing dangerous offenders. | New York City's "sanctuary city" status has allowed the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua to exploit the local migrant shelter system by conducting illegal activities such as trafficking drugs, guns, and women. The city's policies prevent the NYPD from effectively policing these shelters and restrict communication with federal immigration agents, allowing dangerous criminals to be released back into communities rather than being deported. Despite the NYPD's efforts, their operations are often thwarted by internal tip-offs and stringent restrictions on police access to shelters, only allowing entry in cases of emergencies or with a warrant. Critics argue that the city administration should pursue more aggressive measures, including an executive order, to mitigate the negative impacts of the sanctuary city status on law enforcement capabilities. | Denver voters will decide on twelve initiatives in November, including measures to increase sales tax for Denver Health and affordable housing, ban fur products, prohibit slaughterhouses, and expand union bargaining rights. Significant campaign spending, over $22 million, has been reported, with the largest expenditures on initiatives for Denver Health funding and the affordable housing tax increase. The fur product ban, proposed by Pro-Animal Future, faces opposition from groups like Hands Off My Hat, citing negative impacts on agriculture and the Denver Stock Show. The slaughterhouse ban initiative could lead to significant job losses and economic impacts, with substantial funding from both supporters and opponents. Question 2U aims to expand collective bargaining rights to all city employees, drawing considerable financial support from labor organizations, with no reported opposition funding. | The Pueblo City Council held a meeting to discuss a proposed ordinance to ban abortion centers, coinciding with a heated debate on Amendment 79, which aims to establish abortion rights in Colorado and allow public funding for abortions. During the council meeting, arguments were presented about the impact of the Colorado Reproductive Health Equity Act (RHEA) on local governance, with proponents highlighting that it prohibits local government interference with abortion rights. The meeting addressed concerns from local council members about maintaining community standards and local control over abortion legislation, with further discussions and city council meetings planned to explore the possibility of local regulations in response to state laws. | Ahmad Alissa was sentenced to 10 life sentences plus 1,300 years for the mass shooting at a Colorado King Soopers, where he killed 10 people. Victims' families expressed mixed feelings during the sentencing; they acknowledged the justice served but noted the irreplaceable loss of their loved ones. Family members shared poignant impact statements in court, detailing the profound and lasting impact of the tragedy on their lives. A memorial at the King Soopers honors the victims, serving as a site of remembrance and reflection for the community. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY JULIANN MCPADDEN | STATE | SEPTEMBER 25 The 86th annual Colorado Federation of Republican Women’s fall meeting recently concluded in Glenwood Springs. The Leadership Institute provided an informative “Get Out the Vote” and grassroots lobbying workshop. BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | SEPTEMBER 25 While both candidates have successfully identified issues that are top of mind for voters in the U.S. House District 3 race — primarily the economy, border, health care, public lands, agriculture and water issues — a Club 20 debate last week on the Western Slope showcased a sharp contrast in both candidates’ specific policy solutions and demeanor. BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | SEPTEMBER 23 When there’s an emergency — a home break-in, fire or heart attack — Coloradans depend upon emergency responders from the far stretches of the Eastern Plains to the Western Slope and places in between to be there._ Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share? Georgia Public Broadcasting: State Election Board passes new rule ordering hand count of ballots. Election officials aren't happy [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092524_2&amount=25]
In case you missed the news, Team:
" Georgia’s State Election Board passed arguably the most contentious of the new rules it had been considering for conducting elections in the state over the objections of county-level election directors and over the advice of Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr. "
You read that right -- over the objections of the officials who run our elections here in Georgia, even including Republican state AG Chris Car and Republican Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger -- three MAGA-aligned members of the State Election Board approved the rule mandating a hand count of paper ballots at the close of polls at every poll site, before the actual tabulation of votes or before even submitting them to county election heads.
The MAGA acolytes running the board didn't care that their rule change within the 90 days before an election violates federal law. They didn't care that the Attorney General of the state, a member of their own party, said their move wasn't supported by any of Georgia's election laws, suppressive or otherwise. They didn't care that their moves overstepped the legal authority of their board either. They had their marching orders as election deniers and wanted to take every step possible to ensure chaos on Election Day.
So what can we do? if you live in Georgia, vote early or by mail ahead of Election Day to make sure your ballot doesn't get lost in the melee. If you don't live in Georgia but have friends or family who do, encourage them to vote early however they can. And everyone can support our work in Georgia and beyond to protect our elections and our right to vote.
Voters deserve better, Team, both here in Georgia and across the country. Help us restore faith in our elections and defend voting rights by kicking in $25 or whatever you can right now to fight back against election deniers everywhere >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092524_2&amount=25]

Need proof from people here on the ground?
Milton Kidd directs elections in Douglas County. He said he’s already heard from some of his poll workers that they don’t want to do the job if they have to hand count paper ballots at their precincts.
“ That's not a hypothetical; that will happen ,” Kidd said. “ There’s going to be people that are going to be having these conversations across the state of Georgia that are not going to want to be poll workers .”
If that happened, election directors said it would throw another roadblock between the end of the election and something that is in fact mandated by law: the certification of local election results and their transmission to the state.
Georgia House Rep. Saira Draper of District 90 said she couldn’t see how the hand count rule or any of the other rules still under consideration will make the 2024 election better. “ I think what is happening is we are setting up our counties to fail .” Instead of election security, Draper said, the real result of the new rules would likely just be chaos.
The immediate answer -- while these rules are fought in the courts -- is to make sure we get our pro-democracy votes in early so that they don't get caught up in the rush of Election Day.

lost two years later.

Now, we have the opportunity to win them back — flipping House control

spending.

California’s congressional races:

“Call it Democrats’ blue state dilemma, one that has helped make New York and
California, two coastal bastions far from the presidential battlegrounds, the
unlikely heart of the fight for control of the House of Representatives as
summer turns to fall.”

We have the opportunity to change the course of our country’s progress by
flipping control of the House. And it comes down to California.

We can’t count out any district or any opportunity to make a difference in
these toss-up districts in the Golden State, especially with the amount of

September 25, 2024
Having won an uphill battle to secure the Republican nomination, Dr. Michael Goldstein is fighting and entrenched Democratic incumbent who refuses to debate him.
Armed with a war chest of over $2,000,000, much of it from his old pals at Goldman Sachs, Congressman Jim Himes prefers to run out the clock while a compliant media allows him to do so. Even the League of Women Voters doesn't want to bother with the race, offering only to arrange a Zoom debate rather than their usual forum with voter and media attendance.

---|---|---
Dr. Michael Goldstein
Himes's strategy is quite effective to ensure victory, but is this good for Fairfield County? While the perception is that everyone in Fairfield County is fat and happy, this is simply not true.
Housing prices and rents have skyrocketed thanks to the Biden/Harris policies that Jim Himes voted for. Few businesses are moving into the area. Our children cannot afford to live here.
Route 95 and the Merritt Parkway are parking lots. Yet Congressman Himes does not fight for money to change this. According to the [Connecticut Department of Transportation](https://substack.com/redirect/6a590c7d-a1e6-4013-9d52-a33f552559f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), road improvements are being made in Waterbury, Hartford, East Lyme and many other towns. There is even a project t[o improve Route 95 in southeastern Connecticut](https://substack.com/redirect/e5094bf8-deeb-45bc-b20f-d3252c543ad8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) even though the main danger there is falling asleep at the wheel since there is so little traffic! Fairfield County? Zilch.
Why? Because Jim Himes is levering his position on the Intelligence Committee so that he can blather to fawning "journalists" on CNN about the brilliance of the Biden/Harris foreign policy that has caused wars in Ukraine, Israel and Yemen.
Traffic? "So Boring!"
Health care costs? "Manana".
Minority education? "We'll get back to you on that."
Car jackings? "MAGA propaganda."
And one thing is for sure. Should the Goldman Sachs bond portfolio in commercial real estate, corporate debt and China go south, Jim Himes will be there to use taxpayer money to bail them out.
Fairfield County deserves a debate on the issues.

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

body:

# We can’t let hate Win!

---
|
---
|
#
Friends,
As an immigrant from Pakistan and a Muslim American who has been fortunate enough to come to this great country and live the American dream as a doctor serving my community, as well as a serving as a commissioner of the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom, I am deeply saddened and angry over the racist and divisive language used by Donald Trump and J.D. Vance in their attempts to win the election through fear and lies. We cannot let hate win! [**Help out now!**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=5572994a33&e=7b1b739a89)
Recent comments from Trump paint a troubling picture of his fitness to lead our country. His propensity to blame Jewish American’s for his potential electoral losses and to spread falsehoods about Haitian immigrants is not just irresponsible—it's dangerous. Such divisive language fosters hate and discrimination, undermining the fabric of our diverse society.
Moreover, his recent derogatory remarks towards Catholics, and his constant attacks on Muslim Americans and immigrants, demonstrate a blatant disregard for the values that make our nation great: inclusivity, respect, and unity. These actions not only alienate millions of Americans but also pose a direct threat to the principles of democracy and equality that we hold dear.
In contrast, my dear friend Vice President Harris embodies the leadership we need in these tumultuous times. She advocates for unity and understanding, and she is committed to representing all Americans, regardless of their background. It is imperative that we rally behind her and ensure she has the necessary resources to combat the misinformation and fear-mongering tactics that have become all too common in this election. [_**Donate Now**_](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=65897d245b&e=7b1b739a89).
We have just five weeks left, and every moment counts. Let’s work together to amplify her message, support her campaign, and drive voter turnout. Our future depends on it.
Sincerely,
Asif

Hola todos,
Come rain or shine, immigrants nationwide are _here to work_. Whether it’s to better our communities or just put food on the table, Hispanics, and all people of color, are here to work.
So when we see craziness on the news about bomb threats, modern-day lynchings, and the _classic_ “Mexican rapists,” it delegitimizes _everything_ our families, our friends, and our cultures have worked for.
We can’t believe we have to ask this, but do you _genuinely_ think people would risk their lives and futures to come to America just to commit atrocities like these?
Again, **we are here to work** to provide a better future for ourselves and our families.
And in case there was any doubt, work in the U.S. for the Hispanic community isn’t easy. We suffer from wage theft, unsafe working conditions, and discrimination on all fronts. For decades, activists have paved the way for unionization across immigrant-driven, blue-collar jobs, but there is still more to do.
[This Hispanic Heritage Month, we’re urging you to stand with us in the fight for immigrant workers’ rights. Add your name TODAY to fight for unions, on-the-job protections, and much more. Unions are on the rise and they need all of the support they can get!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93565997/500893714/-1587236210?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOGUzZWEyOC02YzdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y8qv17kgS5ZTvxFIV7lzc_uy1HALrX-oRRy4OTfXfEc=&emci=261d9219-667b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=28e3ea28-6c7b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=6787172)

Friend, Growing up in Livingston County, Michigan, I learned early on that true leadership is about serving others. My parents taught me that lesson every day—my father as a teacher, coach, and vice principal, and my mother through her tireless work advocating for small businesses.
_**[That’s where my call to service began, and it’s driven me throughout my life.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=9180ec9357264f6283b8cdce9d48574e&_e=UIsUk5lMD2Y3gvXu9jP4NDdeyck10mqv3nuMaIRT_CiObxHtPQ102R4q4Vbp446xNZvV7lOUGEdZGhLKV82YOoAQISGokl3JrHK_PB7EftzByjNouFch5VCsnLKnfvLPmzZlXSC1kpZNzFLMihXMvGh3mMoJr8KXuyQgFazpO56CzBQN7tT_j4ch5i_NMFTzMq3_F02jJnQJBpxrlyFgfqlUVqkJ4SSeyHEDTuKsMUfsI8P1hBwgijwNI_SREI8FcFWYOk7OF83w-zhCCi4m2G7yd0t7G3WhE7wqW_lS-WR_HcTKVLfT1sq3OS9MmVZyNrtL8U75tLy4JHIcFmuO6u6AWz_jasQ6Rmcovnmt3m5DGHgSH2oUY56pLRs8ez_73Img5yXbKgaoq4L1JWe_jd7fj3qnylW6WQBILR4BCOPH0Pdi-1QoigbZsf4fGqptdat5EPiKKEa4cecdb6VHIRmww6IvIydfQ1rWALV72ts%3D)**_
After graduating from Howell High School and Adrian College, I served our country as an officer in the U.S. Army, then joined the FBI, where I took down organized crime and corruption in Chicago. Seeing the challenges our communities faced first hand, I knew more had to be done. So I ran for public office to serve my neighbors in Michigan. As a State Senator, I worked to make it easier for families to save for college and helped our small businesses thrive. In Congress, I fought to protect Michigan’s jobs and stood strong against threats from China, especially when it came to defending our auto industry.
**[Now, I’m ready to continue that fight in the U.S. Senate—but I need your help.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=9180ec9357264f6283b8cdce9d48574e&_e=UIsUk5lMD2Y3gvXu9jP4NDdeyck10mqv3nuMaIRT_CiObxHtPQ102R4q4Vbp446xNZvV7lOUGEdZGhLKV82YOoAQISGokl3JrHK_PB7EftzByjNouFch5VCsnLKnfvLPmzZlXSC1kpZNzFLMihXMvGh3mMoJr8KXuyQgFazpO56CzBQN7tT_j4ch5i_NMFTzMq3_F02jJnQJBpxrlyFgfqlUVqkJ4SSeyHEDTuKsMUfsI8P1hBwgijwNI_SREI8FcFWYOk7OF83w-zhCCi4m2G7yd0t7G3WhE7wqW_lS-WR_HcTKVLfT1sq3OS9MmVZyNrtL8U75tLy4JHIcFmuO6g9CMqymiynzXLbSKP54J_wU-37wkfMxYmFbmakqSd90Z-XMULacuhEO6O7C9bUPLw0VOMd3kAST9Qgqm5V_vxsjfAeCGemFDHC2dk-QvSCgqOyVHt_LQT3JNEdtkcDoCky7-OQfrBLGy8dDh2WrLMQ%3D)**
This November, Michigan is at a crossroads. Our state’s future is on the line, and the decisions we make at the ballot box will have a profound impact on our families, our jobs, and our national security. **[I’m running to ensure we put Michigan and America first, and to stop the radical policies that are holding us back.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=9180ec9357264f6283b8cdce9d48574e&_e=UIsUk5lMD2Y3gvXu9jP4NDdeyck10mqv3nuMaIRT_CiObxHtPQ102R4q4Vbp446xNZvV7lOUGEdZGhLKV82YOoAQISGokl3JrHK_PB7EftzByjNouFch5VCsnLKnfvLPmzZlXSC1kpZNzFLMihXMvGh3mMoJr8KXuyQgFazpO56CzBQN7tT_j4ch5i_NMFTzMq3_F02jJnQJBpxrlyFgfqlUVqkJ4SSeyHEDTuKsMUfsI8P1hBwgijwNI_SREI8FcFWYOk7OF83w-zhCCi4m2G7yd0t7G3WhE7wqW_lS-WR_HcTKVLfT1sq3OS9MmVZyNrtL8U75tLy4JHIcFmuO6tx4loUCv26sZJAty-hAWQbE1rRCZgHG4FaRedQEAaXujgEb2I0oqm5WxvK8OrtI3bpdi7kGFper_5qCHl3LTctIhmrI5AfARI3V4_BXM01OmkACdFG4IXMYw7KhrMYnUfJ2KZ-R-S-i4V-u4qp33C4%3D)**
But I can’t do it without you. Together, we can win this November and get Michigan back on track.

Your support is critical—please chip in today!](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=9180ec9357264f6283b8cdce9d48574e&_e=UIsUk5lMD2Y3gvXu9jP4NDdeyck10mqv3nuMaIRT_CiObxHtPQ102R4q4Vbp446xNZvV7lOUGEdZGhLKV82YOoAQISGokl3JrHK_PB7EftzByjNouFch5VCsnLKnfvLPmzZlXSC1kpZNzFLMihXMvGh3mMoJr8KXuyQgFazpO56CzBQN7tT_j4ch5i_NMFTzMq3_F02jJnQJBpxrlyFgfqlUVqkJ4SSeyHEDTuKsMUfsI8P1hBwgijwNI_SREI8FcFWYOk7OF83w-zhCCi4m2G7yd0t7G3WhE7wqW_lS-WR_HcTKVLfT1sq3OS9MmVZyNrtL8U75tLy4JHIcFmuO6nU96urZMGUQm1m-akmSk8SWyrScWy7eqHISHTJMRgRAp4H-f9x7nGmvi-dsBWozQIDzxKmHKmlTMaij9Yu1V7kwceL6Zjyouj3cRAWH_UdE6djG-6ei5l-uYzc7SIigAHETtWVSfhIs5JH3XMWsZAA%3D)**

But what’s often under-reported is that we expect Republicans to flood the courts with frivolous lawsuits if things don’t go their way. **This was front and center in 2020 when Donald Trump pushed to overturn the election. In total, Trump and his surrogates filed 62 lawsuits contesting election processes, vote counting, and the vote certification process in nine states.** Winning elections at the ballot box is our first priority. But we need to be ready for what happens on November 6th and beyond. That’s why we’re building a non-negotiable **$5 million dollar fund** to combat challenges in Maine, Michigan, North Carolina and Nevada – and we need your support to get this project fully funded. [Please send in $3 to the DASS Legal Fund today. Dear Friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our culture--entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government.
---
| | As the upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the Bible to guide our decisions? In my new 44-page booklet, _How a Christian Should Vote_ , I offer a biblical framework for assessing candidates, their faith, policies, and constitutional views. This practical resource will help you view the election from a biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.
---

Do the candidate's policies align with the Bible?
What is the candidate's view of Israel?
Will the candidate get things done?

clean_body: I want to help create real change for America | Patriot, When I'm elected to Congress in November, I promise to fight every single day for hard working Americans. As a Green Beret, I understand the real definition of sacrifice and standing up for what we believe in. Now, with the future of our nation on the line, I'm coming to you for help. | I don't enjoy asking you directly for money, so let me tell you exactly what a contribution from you will do. Your contribution will help us place TV ads, radio ads, billboards, send mailers, reach more voters, protect North Carolina from turning blue, and stop the Progressive Agenda the Democrats are promoting. With your support, we can fight for less crime, secure borders, lower taxes, a strong economy, and support hard working Americans. Every dollar that is donated is crucial to fueling our grassroots efforts and influencing real change in our communities. I know the timing is not ideal. Times are tough, and the world is struggling, but our shared purpose and values are bigger than you and me. Together, we can achieve great things. So, I'm kindly asking you to join my team and fuel my fight to work for the hard working American people. Thank you for joining me as we work to secure a brighter future for America. Together, we can secure better lives for our children. We can create a future we will be proud of.
