Do you love our US Border Patrol Agents? So do we!
**DO YOU WANT TO THANK A MEMBER OF OUR BORDER PATROL FOR KEEPING YOUR FAMILY SAFE?**
[YES!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3dc8d90925734f0fac26b93295cc4e06&_e=k_EbLKK2Omeju6pD8uKry4rCBTEYf4WaKGGkP8dEMxI4j46vLFk8O7axN68jflvJtHOklcJ_mUx1RfzSR6WE11kKq4gqgnO5QEBRlyHkcpIg_4cj1l1OOba7UNckN0c0PVEBMF5C_7H2t2vYYFa56yC6ucZqtRkYVk7kiDBZcsQuNsXMNNJ7mYk9d9c0bFitVcUao44Sn03BeQsoAJrhVvHWSIGOUsFaZg7LuRWU6QcymnoArnoSCXqnsyjcGONyB-dIVgBhXPH0ajDk_wpjx5Q31k-IUiOTEzYsngWkuv3S3ytjjkjFbqI4jv3KCyV8o8F_bBepUcFWlC0ggxc_r5Y5my9EQ55cxSPE8y4ah4NxRLDXEOXWB_ZPq92MicHX4Ca90DU36Alq7Un4khJmxA%3D%3D)
[No](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3dc8d90925734f0fac26b93295cc4e06&_e=k_EbLKK2Omeju6pD8uKry4rCBTEYf4WaKGGkP8dEMxI4j46vLFk8O7axN68jflvJtHOklcJ_mUx1RfzSR6WE11kKq4gqgnO5QEBRlyHkcpIg_4cj1l1OOba7UNckN0c0PVEBMF5C_7H2t2vYYFa56yC6ucZqtRkYVk7kiDBZcsQuNsXMNNJ7mYk9d9c0bFitVcUao44Sn03BeQsoAJrhVvHWSIGOUsFaZg7LuRWU6QcymnoArnoSCXqnsyjcGONySmeOPNMi9y2P9Tr41pL9lUSlMUqEmwCD-oRSX8Xo52izcGEUzsInAWttwbEGv4cIDCA2hE4eBfSMyEvLGWIoCFTZL_ad1bvoAGBR-zEfSaNAyftmAvoDreb8SZzC0AeOgVE9awwLRMqmHh4ng-jkXA%3D%3D)

These brave men and women put their lives in harm's way every single day because of the policies of corrupt DC elites who won't secure our border. Let's face it, the crisis at our border is COMPLETELY and TOTALLY out of our control. Radical policies have left us with a WIDE OPEN BORDER.

[SECURE OUR BORDERS](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3dc8d90925734f0fac26b93295cc4e06&_e=k_EbLKK2Omeju6pD8uKry4rCBTEYf4WaKGGkP8dEMxI4j46vLFk8O7axN68jflvJtHOklcJ_mUx1RfzSR6WE11kKq4gqgnO5QEBRlyHkcpIg_4cj1l1OOba7UNckN0c0PVEBMF5C_7H2t2vYYFa56yC6ucZqtRkYVk7kiDBZcsQuNsXMNNJ7mYk9d9c0bFitVcUao44Sn03BeQsoAJrhVvHWSIGOUsFaZg7LuRWU6QcymnoArnoSCXqnsyjcGONyConqoomd_jCytlUW6t6TxixP7oj1q7OI0NWRnxDzcQmW-lm30TtVSkxfR9gnO6itObdFb-c5UDcoKJOPKFeZTsuL0AKRNFNHukKwQb3LbjWhoxJAuU7lD2vW11VroITkF09c62897EPnVp9fRzKASg%3D%3D)

We at the National Faith Advisory Board are committed to recognizing these heroes and their families through a special Family Day filled with fun, prayer, and fellowship. They will receive meals and gift cards for family necessities, showing our deep appreciation for their sacrifices.

[HONOR OUR U.S. BORDER PATROL AGENTS](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3dc8d90925734f0fac26b93295cc4e06&_e=k_EbLKK2Omeju6pD8uKry4rCBTEYf4WaKGGkP8dEMxI4j46vLFk8O7axN68jflvJtHOklcJ_mUx1RfzSR6WE11kKq4gqgnO5QEBRlyHkcpIg_4cj1l1OOba7UNckN0c0PVEBMF5C_7H2t2vYYFa56yC6ucZqtRkYVk7kiDBZcsQuNsXMNNJ7mYk9d9c0bFitVcUao44Sn03BeQsoAJrhVvHWSIGOUsFaZg7LuRWU6QcymnoArnoSCXqnsyjcGONyQ1mS_cIgNAIqjLLoihmZ51DCwDdiAsDAOpBfrN-KFKd-_cah05TDqtRsRhvLpsU5c0IsOwP94vRMpns7Eu0L2Mo8KpZcVwR95cr9EIn7HobSZzZuUAPHHOXZECxww0x4H6P8wqihv5niotGZYV7AQQ%3D%3D)

I'm Paula White, President Trump's personal Pastor, and I founded the National Faith Advisory Board to unify Christians across America on issues that MATTER to People of Faith. Issues like securing our border and keeping our communities SAFE from brutal crimes committed by Illegal Aliens.
President Trump has always been a staunch supporter of the faith-based community and our national security. His dedication to religious freedom and a strong America resonates deeply with our mission. Together, we can continue his legacy of protecting our borders and promoting family values.
Join us in this initiative to SECURE OUR BORDERS. Together, we can make a difference and show our Border Patrol Agents that we stand with them. Let's unite in prayer and action for a safer, stronger America.

subject: 40 Days - What that means now
body:
The first mail-in ballots are arriving and it's time to take action! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=6ff1a7d514)
---
| |
---
|
---
| Peter,

Mail-in ballots are now being sent to voters all over Maryland.
* Neil is up two points in the latest independent polling.
* Fox News named ours one of the five races that will decide control of Congress.
* The NRCC just named Neil Parrott to their "Young Gun" program which will get us more resources as we move toward Election Day.
* We have the momentum.

Predictably, April Delaney is attacking Neil with smears, lies, and over-the-top rhetoric. The desperation is obvious. Her out-of-state, progressive, mega-donors are pouring in the cash to get her advertisements everywhere.

**We are[ calling on every person who is reading this email for support. Please pitch in $4, $14, or $40 or more to help us fund the final 40 days until Election Day.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=52f1e6379b&e=5a45ee1154)**

---
| [DONATE ANY AMOUNT HERE]( "DONATE ANY AMOUNT HERE")
---
| With time running out and Neil's opponent and her allies flooding our district with mailers and commercials featuring lies about my record,****_WE[ NEED ALL HANDS ON DECK!](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=80bd10b245&e=5a45ee1154) _ We need volunteers, we need donors, we need people to spread the word about Neil's common-sense approach to government and problem solving. He is an engineer - a normal guy who has been solving problems for decades!

We cannot do this alone. A handful of motivated people cannot do this alone. We need you. Your support — no matter if it’s _**[$4, $40 or $400](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=ddc1de3db7&e=5a45ee1154)**_ \- is critical to helping us fund the final stretch of Neil's campaign.

_**There is too much on the line to hold back now!**_

We've got a new commercial. Watch it **[HERE](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=c769b291ab&e=5a45ee1154).** Could you help to keep it on the air? It's such an important way to get the message out and to counter Neil's opponent's lies. Will you help?

---
| [DONATE NOW TO KEEP NEIL'S COMMERCIAL ON AIR](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=8689807e46&e=5a45ee1154 "DONATE NOW TO KEEP NEIL'S COMMERCIAL ON AIR")
---
| We’ve entered the most important period of this race. Everything we do now WILL have a massive impact on the outcome of this election and the direction of our country.

That’s why we have to work as hard as possible to pull ahead and close the spending gap with Neil's Biden-Appointed opponent and get our positive, practical message out.

[__**We are asking you personally, and this week is an important one. Could you chip in a donation to Neil's campaign?**__](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=9df0644ab0&e=5a45ee1154)

Working with you for our country,
Team Parrott

| | | **I’m Carmen Goers and **
**I am Running to Change the 8th**
---

Dear Peter,
I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself and share a few of my reasons why I am running for Congress.

My name is Carmen Goers, I am a mom to four daughters and grandma to four grandchildren with a fifth one on the way. I have raised my daughters here in Washington State after being a military spouse. I am a commercial banker by trade and have been working in the 8th Congressional District for over 20 years.

We chose Washington over 20 years ago because of the affordability, safety and access to great education. Today my grandchildren are living in a very different time. We have some of the highest crime rates in the nation, a growing fentanyl crisis and families are struggling to afford basic goods, including groceries and gas.

I have been serving my community since moving here. I have served on numerous boards both public and private. I have served in a prison ministry and on the Auburn Human Services Committee.

As a commercial banker, I have seen what over-regulation and taxation does to our business community. In Congress, I am ready to fight for our business owners, make sure their voices are being heard, and that we work to repeal regulations that are harming our small businesses.

Now, let me tell you about the race. I am facing a well-funded incumbent who has done nothing meaningful for our communities. She’s voted against our law enforcement officers multiple times, supports banning natural gas, and wants to make our groceries more expensive. She is out of touch with what our community needs.

During the primary, I was able to get the support of over 94,000 voters, taking home 45% of the vote. We are within striking distance of a victory, taking five of our six counties by over 10%, and in one county by over 20% -- something that hasn’t happened in a while.

I have a goal for September of getting $50,000. This will allow us to get our message out even further. We are so close to meeting that goal but I still need your help. Please donate today and help me make a change for Washington.

I am a commercial banker by trade and have been working in the 8th Congressional District for over 20 years. We chose Washington over 20 years ago because of the affordability, safety and access to great education. Today my grandchildren are living in a very different time. We have some of the highest crime rates in the nation, a growing fentanyl crisis and families are struggling to afford basic goods, including groceries and gas. I have been serving my community since moving here. I have served on numerous boards both public and private. I have served in a prison ministry and on the Auburn Human Services Committee. As a commercial banker, I have seen what over-regulation and taxation does to our business community. In Congress, I am ready to fight for our business owners, make sure their voices are being heard, and that we work to repeal regulations that are harming our small businesses. Now, let me tell you about the race. I am facing a well-funded incumbent who has done nothing meaningful for our communities. She’s voted against our law enforcement officers multiple times, supports banning natural gas, and wants to make our groceries more expensive. She is out of touch with what our community needs. During the primary, I was able to get the support of over 94,000 voters, taking home 45% of the vote. We are within striking distance of a victory, taking five of our six counties by over 10%, and in one county by over 20% -- something that hasn’t happened in a while. I have a goal for September of getting $50,000. This will allow us to get our message out even further. We are so close to meeting that goal but I still need your help. Please donate today and help me make a change for Washington. | | | | | Every dollar counts in this crucial moment. Contribute here: Or you can mail a check to: Carmen For Congress P.O. Box 2463 Auburn, Washington 98071-2463 Website: | | | | Please let me know if you have any questions. Thank you for standing with me! | | | | | | ---|--- - or |

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93570307/500905301/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240925_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDc3NGY4YS03NDdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r2TTBGM5sTFGwId3E9S1OQ3kjYmaH5lhdYrNNpwzYQU=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93570308/500905302/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240925_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDc3NGY4YS03NDdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r2TTBGM5sTFGwId3E9S1OQ3kjYmaH5lhdYrNNpwzYQU=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. [**Can I count on you to join our coalition today by chipping in $3 toward our $10,000 September goal? If thousands of people like you each chip in what they can afford, I know we can take on their dark money and reclaim our House Majority. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93570309/500905303/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240925_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDc3NGY4YS03NDdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r2TTBGM5sTFGwId3E9S1OQ3kjYmaH5lhdYrNNpwzYQU=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $3 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93570316/500905310/-723981995?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20240925_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDc3NGY4YS03NDdiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r2TTBGM5sTFGwId3E9S1OQ3kjYmaH5lhdYrNNpwzYQU=)

subject: Can we try again?
body:
This morning, we sent an email trying to explain why a well-timed donation to the DNC was the best way for someone to contribute to and make a difference in this election.
---
This morning, we sent an email trying to explain why a well-timed donation to the DNC was the best way for someone to contribute to and make a difference in this election. We talked about the work we're doing to reach the relatively small number of voters in the relatively small number of states and races that will determine control of the White House, House, and Senate. Maybe you missed it. Maybe it wasn't compelling enough. So we hope you'll give us a second to try again with a new approach -- because, truly, Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats everywhere need the DNC to have the resources to fund our plans to win this November. Let's start with what we're asking for. $3. That is the donation we're asking you to make today. $3 because the DNC is the organization best positioned to move resources where they are needed, when they are needed most to help Democrats win. $3 because the DNC is doing the hard work of talking directly to the persuadable voters and infrequent voters we need to reach and turnout in order to win. $3 because the most important FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign is coming up in a few days and when it ends we've got some election-deciding budget decisions to make. We can't fund a winning program without lots and lots of donations. So we're asking: [**Can you make that $3 donation to the Democratic National Committee today? Do it before our FEC fundraising deadline ends and we make some election-deciding spending decisions.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240925_1530_fr&refcode2=1554_22930333_CmQ7uP&akid=1554%2E22930333%2ECmQ7uP) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20240925_1530_fr&refcode2=1554_22930333_CmQ7uP&akid=1554%2E22930333%2ECmQ7uP)**

**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**ICYMI: Min Passes Anti-Corruption Legislation**
**By Yusra Farzan, in LAist** Senate Bill 1111 would make it a crime in California for elected officials to be involved in awarding government contracts to organizations if they know their child is an officer or director of the vendor, or has at least 10% ownership. State Sen. Dave Min introduced the bill, and said LAist’s reporting led him to take on the issue. The bill has been significantly narrowed since it was introduced. Newsom has until Sept. 30 to sign the bill into law. _[Read The Full Article Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=30bb8d900c&e=7017cc100e)_

# Hello Peter!
---
| We are 40 days away from the election!
Over the last several weeks, my fellow Democrats and I have worked in DC to fund the government and ensure government workers and citizens receive the paychecks their families depend on. But due to House Republican’s internal chaos and failed leadership, we are likely to pass a continuing resolution that only keeps the government open for three months while kicking the can down the road on funding the government.
The contrast in this election couldn’t be more clear. We need to elect Hakeem Jeffries as our next Speaker so Congress can get back to doing its job.
Back home in Oregon, our team has been busy door knocking as we rapidly expand our canvassing events in every county in the district.
Thank you for all you do to support this campaign. My job is to hold this seat and continue delivering for Oregonians, and I can’t do it without you.
---
|
---
|
# Volunteer Opportunities
We have several exciting volunteer opportunities coming up, and we would love for you to be a part of them. Whether you have a few hours to spare or can commit to helping on a weekly basis, your help is invaluable to us!
**Canvasses** Help engage voters for the 2024 election through direct conversations about what is at stake this election. This is a great way to engage with your local community and spread our campiagn’s message.
**Eugene Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am
* Location: IAFF Firefighters Union Hall 160 Madison St, Eugene, OR 97402

**Corvallis Canvass with Commissioner Nancy Wyse**
* Date and Time: Saturday September 28th at 10am and 1pm
* Location: Benton County Democrats Office 425 SW Madison Ave Corvallis, OR 97333

**North Albany Canvass for Val Hoyle**
* Date and Time: Sunday September 29th at 10:00am
* Location: North Albany Park 2800 Hillcrest St NW Albany, OR 97321

**Coos Bay Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 9:00am
* Location: 791 Virginia Ave North Bend, OR 97459

**Brookings Canvass**
* Date and Time: Saturday September 28th at 10:00am
* Location: Curry Democrats 619 Chetco Ave Brookings, OR 97415

**Gold Beach Canvass**
* Date and Time: Sunday September 29th at 9:30am
* Location: RSVP for location

**Port Orford Canvass**
* Date and Time: Sunday September 29th at 1pm
* Location: RSVP for location

**Phone banking for Volunteers** Help our campaign recruit more volunteers by joining our phone bank. We’ll be reaching out to past volunteers and ask them to get involved this cycle.
* Date and Time: Every Wednesday at 6:00pm
* Location: Zoom-RVSP for the link!

---
[RSVP](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=002433fb44&e=9659e2eb5e)
|

|
**Upcoming Events**
**Tim Walz Debate Watch Parties**
**VP Debate Watch Party with the Benton County Democrats**
* Date and Time: Tuesday October 1st at 5:45pm
* Location: Tunison Park Community Room 365 SW Tunison Ave, Corvallis, OR 97333

---
[RSVP](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=9b937d37d6&e=9659e2eb5e)
| **VP Debate Watch Party with Val Hoyle & the Democratic Party of Lane County**
* Date and Time: Tuesday October 1st at 5:30pm
* Location: Whirled Pies 199 W 8th Ave Eugene, OR 97401

---
[RSVP](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=cb4a75f28a&e=9659e2eb5e)
|
---
| **Lawn Signs**
If you would like a Val Hoyle Lawn Sign, you can either pick one up in person from your local County Democratic Party Headquarters or you can sign up on our website for one.
---
[Request a Lawn Sign](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=c9044dce81&e=9659e2eb5e)
|
---
| **Message from the Congresswoman**
---
| During the presidential debate, Trump made it clear that he and other National Republican leaders support the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade.
Trump even had the audacity to say “the Supreme Court had great courage” in overturning Roe v. Wade. He also failed to say he would veto a national abortion ban, something that the vast majority of Americans oppose.
Over the last several months, we have seen the tragic consequences of extreme abortion bans around the US as women are unable to get the healthcare they need and maternal deaths are on the rise.
This election is about protecting our freedoms all across the country, including here in Oregon. I will always fight to protect a woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions and will oppose any effort to pass a national ban on abortion or contraception.
Sincerely,

_Hey there, it's Nikki. I wanted to pass along this message from my friend, Kirsten Engel who's running to flip Arizona's 6th District blue._
* * *

subject: What I'm doing for the November Election
body:
| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/34e89f85593c/what-im-doing-for-the-november-election?e=b4b662832c)
---
| | | | |
---
|
# What I’m doing for November
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Friends,

I am reaching out after a long time because I appreciated your support in the past when I was running for Congress (thank you again) and I wanted to update you on my current efforts to help **win both the House and the White House on November 5.** (If you want to skip the explanation, here is a [link to volunteer](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=077af64d34&e=b4b662832c) and here is a [link to support](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=22c12f4772&e=b4b662832c).)
---
| Running for Congress twice taught me many things but in particular, that most campaigns don’t use our resources most effectively to win elections. You can read [my full post here](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=db3cb6b51f&e=b4b662832c), but the gist is:
1. Most campaign money is spent on advertising, whose effectiveness is measured through polls (which are often very inaccurate) and I have found little correlation between advertising dollars and performance on election day.

2. Most volunteer time is spent on calling strangers or knocking on strangers’ doors. But most people do not open their door to strangers, and the vast majority of people (75%) do not answer unknown phonecalls, so we end up talking to a very small number of voters.

So what is the alternative to “phonebanks?” Friendbanks (reaching out to people you know). Many of you did this for my own campaigns, but if you didn’t it’s actually relatively simple. You download an app ([REACH](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=8459353a64&e=b4b662832c)) that lets you match the people you know to registered voters and track whether they vote or not, so you can reach out to them if they don’t. It may sound too easy, but look at the numbers: If everyone in Texas who donated/volunteered for Democrats had done this in 2020 and they had found just**4 extra votes each** in their phones (very easy to do), we would have won the state. This is by far the fastest and easiest way to get extra votes, and we can reach people who have been impossible to contact with cold calls.
Based on this experience, in 2020, I helped build a successful relational organizing network of 160,000 voters in Georgia. In 2022, I helped build a network of over 500,000 in Texas, and now I’m focusing my efforts on building networks for November in the 11 highest impact districts in the country: swing congressional districts in the swing states that will decide the presidency **(Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, Arizona, and Nevada.)** We have named this effort**CAT PAC.**
If you **know anyone** who lives in these states, or even better if you can **recruit anyone** who lives in these states to do this program, we have “friendbanks” going on continuously until the election. [Please sign up here to join us!](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=3410dfc1a6&e=b4b662832c)
---
| And if you don’t know anyone who lives in those states but want to contribute to the effort, [**here is a link to donate**](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=263f81eb4a&e=b4b662832c). We have also created a sharable image with a QR code:
---
| In gratitude,
Sri
---

Our mailing address is:
Congressional Anti-Tyranny PAC 12440 Emily Ct Ste 302 Sugar Land, TX 77478-4539 USA

Want to change how you receive these emails?You can [update your preferences](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/profile?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=c5fe27d329&e=b4b662832c&c=2f95826357) or [unsubscribe](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=c5fe27d329&t=b&e=b4b662832c&c=2f95826357)

Hey there,
**The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me.
**If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life.
**I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table.
**I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike.
There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **SIX new polls show I am neck-and-neck with my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. One even shows me LEADING by 2 points!**
I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat in November. But I need your help to do it.

| **Dr. Brian Williams** | Welcome
---|---
|
## **Thanks for joining our movement to create justice**
---
Peter — Thank you for joining me on this journey to create a safer, healthier future for all. Your support is invaluable as we fight for health justice and an end to gun violence. I'm excited to share my experiences with you—from the frontlines of trauma surgery to my campaign for Congress and the publication of my book, _[The Bodies Keep Coming: Dispatches from a Black Trauma Surgeon On Racism, Violence, And How We Heal](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbrianwilliamsmd.com%2Fbook%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66f46c2f842f3601883b2601%26ss_email_id%3D66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f%26ss_campaign_name%3DOur%2Bmovement%2Bto%2Bcreate%2Bjustice%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-25T20%253A05%253A01Z&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=Dl-jeR3Mtu4K60P0Kk4bZpEW8ME%3D)_.
---
| [](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbrianwilliamsmd.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66f46c2f842f3601883b2601%26ss_email_id%3D66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f%26ss_campaign_name%3DOur%2Bmovement%2Bto%2Bcreate%2Bjustice%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-25T20%253A05%253A01Z&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=0u4Z4x5PtSmzcQNSPeuuT0SLx6w%3D)
---
My experience as a trauma surgeon, witnessing the daily devastation of gun violence, compelled me to run for Congress. Especially, the endemic violence taking the lives of young Black men—a reality that seemed minimized in the national debate about saving lives. Although I did not win my election, it was still a success—providing a [national platform to share my frontline experiences and advocate for systemic change](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DKzXmi8Ui3mI&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=2janV6u3vzCmmp4C1ABnrFBy_sk%3D).
---
| [](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DKzXmi8Ui3mI&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=2janV6u3vzCmmp4C1ABnrFBy_sk%3D)
---
| **I spoke with Gayle King on CBS Mornings about my campaign for Congress and** _**The Bodies Keep Coming.**_
---
**I am deeply grateful for the support I received and remain dedicated to amplifying the voices of those most impacted by gun** **violence, and working toward meaningful policy reform.** I wrote _[The Bodies Keep Coming](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.broadleafbooks.com%2Fstore%2Fproduct%2F9781506483122%2FThe-Bodies-Keep-Coming&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=H_D0yfG00SQgrOm4mGDkcBKi9GE%3D)_ to provide an unflinching look at how gun violence and health disparities intersect in America, sharing the devastating impact of preventable firearm injuries and the root causes of health inequity. This book is not only a memoir, but also a call to action, urging us to confront these systemic issues, support impacted communities, and strive for a more just and equitable healthcare system. As I continue my national book tour, I hope you'll join me in sharing these stories and advocating for change.
---
---
| [](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbrianwilliamsmd.com%2Fbook%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66f46c2f842f3601883b2601%26ss_email_id%3D66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f%26ss_campaign_name%3DOur%2Bmovement%2Bto%2Bcreate%2Bjustice%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-25T20%253A05%253A01Z&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=Dl-jeR3Mtu4K60P0Kk4bZpEW8ME%3D)
---
[_ _**ORDER A SIGNED COPY OF** _**THE BODIES KEEP COMING**_ _ _](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbrianwilliamsmd.com%2Fbook%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66f46c2f842f3601883b2601%26ss_email_id%3D66f46cd74a151d36e85ede0f%26ss_campaign_name%3DOur%2Bmovement%2Bto%2Bcreate%2Bjustice%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-25T20%253A05%253A01Z&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f46c2f842f3601883b2601&l=en-US&s=Dl-jeR3Mtu4K60P0Kk4bZpEW8ME%3D)
---
**What’s next?
**Your support is essential in our fight for health justice and an end to gun violence. Let's keep building on our momentum and pushing for lasting change. I’ll keep you informed through my monthly newsletter, where I'll share updates, insights, and strategies critical to our movement. Reply to this email if you have questions or requests for newsletter topics.**Onward,
Brian**

Folks, this is Senator Tina Smith from Minnesota.
Recently, I joined with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to write a bold, progressive, and comprehensive plan to address the housing crisis. [Before I share more about our plans, will you split a contribution of $5 to our campaigns so we can keep up this important work?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240925-smith.c278mR&refcode=em20240925-7262-P_FND_ANO_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7262%2E2526796%2EPc0_Q-)

It’s no secret that our country is facing a serious housing crisis — the impacts are far-reaching, from our largest cities to our smallest towns.
That’s why I’m joining Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to create a plan to make renting and owning a home a reality for millions of Americans.
When we talk about the “housing crisis,” it’s easy to get lost in jargon and policy specifics, but the reality is as simple as this: _this crisis impacts real Americans every day._
Alexandria and I have heard from countless people, from New York to Minnesota and everywhere in between, that the cost of housing is simply too high.
Our plan is about giving hard-working families the opportunity to put a roof over their heads without breaking the bank. To give kids a home. To give young people the opportunity to build equity and pursue the American dream.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hi Peter,
Welcome to my team’s monthly newsletter of what I’ve been up to this month, so you can be in the loop about the great work happening.
I know life can be busy, and your inbox can get filled up with political emails, so I appreciate any time you can dedicate to reading this newsletter each month.
Thanks!

Portland is getting a WNBA team!

The Governor emphasized the importance of regular school attendance for students’ sense of belonging, achievement, and graduation.

Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek visit with members of the Tribe [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe7OGomlKAFKyG8dtQv2HmOwmr1QGLsaih8ov45p3dvw6e2vcB8V0OmyiwZ7Fb3ZBCO4-M2FpV2JcdXih0H04V2RoS-FKXtbNccYwXpGG-PYGHzMFWb0jlr5HpabjtwNeUDBBJm_P65VuqGFNOWWX_-hRo?key=R0B_JyEYOGcHmZ7oDh93UQ]

The visit completes Governor Kotek’s commitment to visit all of Oregon’s nine federally recognized sovereign Tribal nations in 2024.

Calling on President Biden to Protect the Owyhee Canyonlands.

SIGN THE PETITION [https://www.protecttheowyhee.org/]

ICYMI in August: Celebrating a $50 million award from the federal CHIPs Act.

Governor Kotek takes photo with business leaders [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc-nFzqtwr9-22-4_yV4-xTy8F2DY-cZyPzP9s59aDpYKRwQF7nbbaf2zVa8g33GQM2xmWQZtCtscphIvnjdnmAmtG4NbxAaZf0c8GS0-snUI1mvURQqQlrwWIArUZjWMwED6mYK9w4TaDgIDp4p9AcJnn_?key=R0B_JyEYOGcHmZ7oDh93UQ]

The CHIPs and Science Act award is $50 million to bolster HP’s semiconductor research and manufacturing efforts in Corvallis.

Peter, After almost a year waging a US-backed genocidal rampage in Gaza with impunity, Israel is now setting its deadly sights on Lebanon.

This escalation began last week with a series of attacks where ordinary objects like pagers and walkie talkies were remotely detonated as deadly explosives, killing dozens and injuring thousands. On Sunday, former CIA Director Leon Panetta weighed in on this chilling development: _“The ability to be able to place an explosive in technology that is very prevalent these days and turn it into a war of terror. This is something new. This has gone right into the supply chain. When you have terror going into the supply chain, it makes people ask the question,_**_‘What the hell is next?’_** _

_That’s a disturbing question, made even more so by the fact that it’s being asked by a former CIA Director, while the silence from Kamala Harris, who is vying to be our next Commander in Chief, has been deafening. Meanwhile the escalation continues as Israel has been launching deadly missile attacks in Lebanon that have killed at least 550 people, including at least 90 women and children and have injured thousands more.

The genocidal Israeli regime no longer even tries to hide its bloodthirsty intentions towards Lebanon and its neighbors in the Middle East. with deep connections to leftwing billionaire George Soros, is

The Facebook (now Meta) censorship board stacked with leftists,
many with deep connections to leftwing billionaire George Soros, is
considering if social media posts complaining about transgender
females—biological men who claim to be in the wrong body and
identify as women—constitute hate speech, bullying or harassment.
This is relevant because the oversight board, as it is officially
known, determines which posts get blocked from the world’s most
popular social networking website which has an estimated 5 billion
users. Other topics recently considered by the board include whether
anti-immigration posts fall under hate speech since Meta has declared
that refugees, migrants and asylum seekers are protected against
“the most severe attacks” on its platforms.

Earlier this month, Maryland’s Prescription Drug Affordability Board took first steps to lower prescription drug prices by publishing its plan for upper payment limits on drugs for state and local employees. This comes shortly after Medicare published the results of its negotiations on ten high-priced drugs, resulting in an expected 83 million dollars in savings for Virginians on Medicare alone. https://www.wypr.org/wypr-news/2024-09-10/maryland-drug-affordability-board-takes-step-to-limit-drug-prices [https://www.wypr.org/wypr-news/2024-09-10/maryland-drug-affordability-board-takes-step-to-limit-drug-prices]

These steps taken by Maryland and other states with Prescription Drug Affordability Boards are making a huge difference in the lives of citizens who rely on life-saving medications. Virginians spend more money on their prescriptions than most Americans. In 2020, Virginians spent 36% more per person on prescription drugs than the national average - $1500 compared to $1100 nationally [https://altarum.org/sites/default/files/uploaded-publication-files/Virginia%27s%20Health%20Care%20Sector%20Economic%20Trends%20in%202020.pdf] . With the high prices of prescription drugs, many Virginians are being forced to choose between life-saving medications and their everyday expenses like rent, childcare, and groceries. It’s time for a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia.

clean_body: Power our work in this critical election year | | | What if we told you there’s an easy way to help protect the freedom to vote without even thinking about it — something that you can start doing today? Our dedicated team of monthly donors — Democracy Defenders — play a key role in how we’re able to respond to voter suppression efforts whenever and wherever they emerge. Monthly donations make it easier to plan our budget, ensuring our team can build long-lasting programs, create comprehensive training and education plans, and invest consistently in increasing access to the ballot box for everyone. = | = We’re seeing a nationally coordinated scheme to keep ballot access as far out of reach as possible, especially for Black and brown, young, disabled, unhoused, and rural voters. Election denier extremists are paving the way here in Georgia, starting with mass voter purges, attempting to disrupt the election certification process, and upending election administration. From training cohorts of Democracy Warriors to make their voices heard on voting access, to empowering people who have been historically shut out of the process with accurate and timely voting information, the Fair Fight team is committed to making sure all voters can access the ballot box, freely and fairly. Recurring, sustained support will help ensure we can revamp up our efforts before, during, and after elections. It’s the best way to support voting rights year round. = Your support moves us forward — thank you. subject: Reminder: Women Evangelicals for Harris Call Mon. 9/30
body:
You're Invited - Monday September 30 7 pm ET | |
---
| | | As women Evangelicals for Harris supporters, your commitment to electing Vice President Harris as our next President is critical, so we're inviting you to a special zoom call created by and for women on [Monday September 30 at 7 pm ET](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=7e2901e705&e=43463f1dee).

Join with us and other women to pray and be encouraged, discuss issues of concern, and learn accessible ways you can engage and build support for Vice President Harris in these remaining 40 days until the election.

**Please join us Monday September 30 at 7 pm ET by registering [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=2131be9f49&e=43463f1dee). _This is an off the record conversation._**

We understand you're busy with life's obligations, so we're grateful for your time to join us Monday September 30 at 7 pm ET. Together, we'll make a positive impact for our families, communities, and world by Electing Vice President Harris as our next President.

_**"Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."**_ (Joshua 1:9)

Thank you for all you're doing. We're praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

Fellow American,

This isn’t the news I wanted to share with less than 50 days until Election Day and less than 20 days before early voting starts...

According to the latest polling, **_we’re losing._**

Report after report shows that the Senate majority will go to Montana—but if the election were held RIGHT NOW, we’d come up short.

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter,
By all accounts, I shouldn’t be alive.

As a Green Beret, I embarked on some of the most dangerous missions of our military.

I fought terrorists face to face, and I came within inches of America’s worst enemies.

I saw the absolute worst of humanity, and there were a LOT of close calls.

**By the grace of God, I came out the other side and came home to my family after every mission. **

After I finished my service as a Green Beret, I knew I could never look at life the same way.

_But that was a good thing - because I was ready to do whatever it took in my new phase of life to defend the freedoms that my fellow soldiers and I fought for. _

**That’s why I decided to run for Congress.**

Right now, we could very well lose our country and EVERYTHING our brave servicemembers have risked their lives for.

Swamp politicians are more interested in serving special interests than the people who voted for them.

Woke indoctrination is threatening our military’s effectiveness and lethality.

Terrorists are crossing into America through our border.

_And members of Congress who SWORE to protect the Constitution are betraying our country and praising terrorism and communism. _

Enough is enough.

I’ve never stood on the sidelines when America needed me before, and right now is no different.

**And just like during my service as a Green Beret, I need an A-Team by my side to do it. **

**[**Today, I have one humble request for you: can you pitch in just $7 to my campaign so we can keep up our fight for America?**](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=16d9acf3a3d24dd09c2f8ada20c1f733&_e=tYtZPJw-fz013SQxgOO8PRMbKyqaPvXuyZl_YXH0bnsl1Qv6Lwws6_SZXky5U8Bef-jkmov5zlXg2bnN0yQZpnmH5m3a1L21fMHSbdvgL6-FmMZUKEoUApHs2HPPSXXAlXO_muoWZbdICYWk4gbKz-Dtwy-iNfZ13_xIz8jy3lCQuuaOFY3hqVrFSKT1eRfFdGbq2pRr-B08JMebvEE760OjbN0qhayvWX0KMjEImmQsDbVMY6dZExzFDLE5Nfx5yR7Gaehb6DMJlfwAv2bajGpI_w2Z148tuY1yFSG4Y84wDxnWxZ-19h48MVpVkP7bi2h3K-36nDwy4ZYGqS10WKze3fCAupDmrX3uWt5AijANuk18xOPEt3Dp3KFc2c6f)**

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan as Speaker = Project 2025
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Earlier this week, I warned you about Jim Jordan’s latest moves – but the more you dig into his agenda, the clearer it becomes: his next run at House Speaker will be much worse.
If Republicans keep control of the House, Jordan will be in a good position to become Speaker. With his hand on the gavel, he’ll push his radical Project 2025 vision on all of us.
Let’s talk about what that actually means.
Project 2025 is a blueprint for dismantling the very protections and life-saving services that everyday Americans rely on.
Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA allies have made it clear – they’re coming for Social Security and Medicare. In his last run for Speaker, Jordan’s allies made it clear that their top reason for supporting him was his goal of ELIMINATING Social Security altogether.
Given the chance, Jordan and his MAGA cronies will gut these programs in the name of "fiscal responsibility," leaving millions of seniors and vulnerable Americans without a safety net.
But that’s just the start.
Under Project 2025, Jordan would strip away worker protections, giving more power to big corporations and making it harder for workers to organize or even fight for fair wages or safe working conditions.
The environmental regulations that protect our air, water, and land? He’ll gut those, too – all to benefit polluters and corporate donors.
Can you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can right now to stop Jim Jordan’s rise and protect our democracy from his dangerous agenda? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240925_jordan_speaker2_link1]
Jordan has made no secret of his intention to use the full weight of the government to subpoena, defame, and imprison his political enemies – just like he’s tried to do with whistleblowers and those who dare stand up to him.
Jordan’s vision is one of chaos and cruelty – in fact, it’s already started.
Over the last few weeks, his dangerous lies about Haitian immigrants in Ohio have led to bomb threats and fear in our communities.
Now he’s aiming for the Speaker’s gavel, and if he succeeds, he’ll bring that same chaos to the entire country.
Project 2025 envisions a world where the rich get richer, workers have fewer rights, and political enemies are silenced.
And a national abortion ban. The Republican Party is hell bent on sending women back decades. I’ll be damned if I let that happen!
That’s the world Jim Jordan wants to create, and the most terrifying part? He’s closer than ever to making it a reality.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because if we don’t stop Jordan here in Ohio, all of America will be living under his far-right dystopia.
It’s time to act.
Donate today and help us take down Jim Jordan before it’s too late. Together, we can stop him from destroying our future and ensure Ohio – and America – move forward, not backward. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240925_jordan_speaker2_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Friend, before I ask you to chip in to help me win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue, I want to take a moment to explain why this is so important.
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter.
**I’ll be honest with you, friend:** Over the years in Ohio, we've seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of bad trade deals, prices skyrocketing as wages failed to keep up, and hopes for a comfortable retirement dashed.

**That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the belief that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do. **
But my MAGA opponent can't say the same. He’s backing terrible pieces of Trump and Vance’s Project 2025, which would eliminate overtime protections and end unions as we know them. It’s an affront to the good folks of Ohio and across America who work hard every day to support themselves and their families.

So now I’m in the fight of my life to defend Ohio’s seat and our Democratic Senate majority. I'm down 2 points in a recent poll, and national Republicans are outspending us 2-to-1 to flip this seat.

I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter. I’ll be honest with you, friend: Over the years in Ohio, we've seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of bad trade deals, prices skyrocketing as wages failed to keep up, and hopes for a comfortable retirement dashed. That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the belief that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do. But my MAGA opponent can't say the same. He’s backing terrible pieces of Trump and Vance’s Project 2025, which would eliminate overtime protections and end unions as we know them. It’s an affront to the good folks of Ohio and across America who work hard every day to support themselves and their families. So now I’m in the fight of my life to defend Ohio’s seat and our Democratic Senate majority. I'm down 2 points in a recent poll, and national Republicans are outspending us 2-to-1 to flip this seat. I can't win without your help. So just 13 days out from the start of early in-person voting, I'm asking:= This might be shocking, but our race is not only the most expensive Senate race in the country – it's the most expensive Senate race in history. And it's because national Republicans know it'll decide Senate control, so they're spending everything they can to defeat me. Now, the latest polls show me falling behind. I simply cannot win this race – and Democrats simply cannot hold on to our narrow Senate majority – without your grassroots support, friend. That's why I'm personally asking:= It means the world to have you on my team, friend. If you're with me down the stretch, I know we can win. With gratitude, = Please read on for a personal message from Sen. Sherrod Brown: Friend – thank you for being a part of our grassroots movement and for sharing our commitment to the Dignity of Work. Fighting for workers means building an economy that prioritizes the needs of workers over tax breaks for billionaires and corporations. No matter who you are or what kind of work you do, I promise to fight for you. But I need your help: Experts say I'm one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection and Senate control could come down to Ohio. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39TrV0WcG36kQ1-skq_qcCghtHqfPwADgISS6xDAViz0kojsFpeOM8czHPEWDNfj3ippZ-hIfgjPlRtO95xAx8CzX26Cogdzzds485ZLBKnHFBmHk4m-ZxJMNaB81K3_W8Mkul5es__aM4PQuOE5nRVJa3HpSkFg-SB9DFcDGLIFbnTlqYGH1pVXO6u9hV_5CTs3La2rR8UtKzBEjYpf8V_0uhoOuOYHtcxXQCfQXK0hgTk0HGwyClnROpsDdS7RczmqDLnP21UWx3_urgyhFpWvVJxszd7yITPRGNVvsg93TnaKE7n2OS8ZeB6IarPYBNnRD1jge7XlgsXmRp_RytQsdCvo_oGS0Zv46_fnsYRUhvry1v6B_JIo-353Aqez-w/4a2/SxpYO0X3SdWW2aoD32Da8A/h1/h001.75WhUfNvGgbdwDDXzCvNV16MMu3GBR_DQYIBJXOLnu0) Instead of negotiating fairly, Marathon has stalled for more than seven months since the Teamsters’ most recent agreement expired. **While workers are on strike, Marathon brought in out-of-state workers not trained to operate this plant, putting the safety of our whole community at risk.** When I spoke to some of the workers on the picket line, they said alarms and sirens have been going off inside the plant. An operator who’s worked at Marathon for 15 years told a reporter that the new workers are “not familiar with my unit, or with where the fire extinguishers are.” This is dangerous. clean_body: | | | Friend, My team and I have been joining the picket line to support 300 members of Teamsters Local 283 who are on strike at Marathon Petroleum in Detroit as they fight for better working conditions, safety, and fair wages. Instead of negotiating fairly, Marathon has stalled for more than seven months since the Teamsters’ most recent agreement expired. While workers are on strike, Marathon brought in out-of-state workers not trained to operate this plant, putting the safety of our whole community at risk. When I spoke to some of the workers on the picket line, they said alarms and sirens have been going off inside the plant. An operator who’s worked at Marathon for 15 years told a reporter that the new workers are “not familiar with my unit, or with where the fire extinguishers are.” This is dangerous. Our Rooted in Community Leadership PAC team has been dropping off food and drinks to people on the picket line, but these striking workers need more support. Let’s amplify their voices. | The biggest crude oil refiner in the United States, Marathon Petroleum can afford to pay their workers fairly! Workers helped the corporation make $14 billion in profits last year. Instead, Marathon is hiring security guards to film the Teamsters on strike, which is a form of intimidation. Some of the striking workers have also said that the replacement workers are being paid double. One told a reporter: “The amount of money they've spent on the strike already is more than we were asking for.” That’s outrageous. Thank you for supporting striking workers who have won transformative changes in the United States and who continue to push for the rights we all deserve. | Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea18e7054a2640418acb9a0c3df015a7&_e=4YijTkIiy4aJsWtj83FLcRoZgKIyqJwCIFp7JBgec-4HuhSeKBPHp4KCcSdG1FTeaL4JzhsfRwygh9EzU-b86c0DBX2KH2tA5acG7mM11Tq4n1Y6bHcsvxydSeGfl0stie9M8jg7wc9veoTDIk4TQ0TIf2RBimrvNWt8xl8H0FszBBk_KT89d1mgIBzZkA2ITn1c_uY7emQXkkcM1w3zAScxRmLwAN5ty-GvkXsDJrOYjFJs-xpd_eLZX_DUQvEuURAQv7XG3oWG1adqtuu4VFUv-EnGRV-rKm2ZtP6S2gHdx6w0vp7uejjPj2pl0uctiFdV8BrS4cHEHJTJBp5yjZ5q1k5ID6NJu7JQj--LlTXBMZZ_sfGWSlz0aPEo4E1V2KagKwQpwOHazQWCVs9hLiAEPwgKj8cREYwYZQkWBVwWkBht2Wkw67KCfEdJX1Jg) [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ea18e7054a2640418acb9a0c3df015a7&_e=4YijTkIiy4aJsWtj83FLcRoZgKIyqJwCIFp7JBgec-4HuhSeKBPHp4KCcSdG1FTeaL4JzhsfRwygh9EzU-b86c0DBX2KH2tA5acG7mM11Tq4n1Y6bHcsvxydSeGfl0stie9M8jg7wc9veoTDIk4TQ0TIf2RBimrvNWt8xl8H0FszBBk_KT89d1mgIBzZkA2ITn1c_uY7emQXkkcM1w3zAScxRmLwAN5ty-GvkXsDJrOYjFJs-xpd_eLZX_DUQvEuURAQv7XG3oWG1adqtuu4VLo0yfmSkd8GkYyaFYKcS6OBPmZuyZ-2m4cSzHVzt02AaNyKgT7GqaybOLaCGlKXKdrU1RSBfzo7bvPPwjLWXNS2ifzbLlxJHYLZfJLedVHSBfHI0OXhGwUz61aqwftktpxX5zbIIbKon83h-a-CmBnaUif93Lh9ZsMYISRfKKfI) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

Dr. Ben Carson

subject: The American Dream Story

body:
| | | Friend,

**My family's story is the American Dream story.** Many years ago, there was a little boy in Starkville, Mississippi who lived across the street from Mississippi State but couldn’t go there because he’s black. _Despite growing up in the Jim Crow South, he refused to let vulnerability become victimhood._ He paid his way through college, served honorably in Vietnam, and started a trucking company with one truck, one trailer and no excuses – hauling BEER back and forth between Detroit and Milwaukee. I grew up in awe of that story. Because it was my Dad’s story. He and my mother raised me – never telling me that this is a racist country. Even though they endured racism—it didn’t define the nation they loved. They taught me I could do anything I set my mind to. They taught me service before self. I went to West Point, became a Ranger-qualified Apache pilot, and flew 750 combat hours in Operation Iraqi Freedom. By the grace of God, I came home and helped grow my family’s business. **Now I have the honor of representing Michigan’s 10th Congressional District.** As a dad of three boys, my biggest concern right now— my biggest fear— is that children today will think that the American Dream is just a myth. **[Will you join me in restoring the American Dream for our children?](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=1d540b30b57f4f74a2ccade6857457f8&_e=9VK9XX6DIZjsK6IV2rPHqFYjf8lEdmdSk5UyFyTxI0V7jiPv113FJP2pkzPIB1A5cRrbtByOAmW7cNHKI1HKhPuFSVGi0eoHfBAYO3dbCDcsfd8Q0rQck_D_jW9lUh3ry5SdtBjpuWDBrUNoorNDa4diGyqzw5CgMQeWwV9F11GaRIpriWOSBnQM-4hA4KPlH44e6dNZkI6v-Ix44UL87ke68EJn-ryIWww2dsc7Vi_czmVhvMBS_i7AUURZiHAs5wfcxY5NtxgSNKEJFw1i8_HN36EwHdibA4VHDbBpeftTFaurkWVlNSaoUUAu0kb2n9wwfHJRg0tk2XECsrYpK0GYFWLl-FNsxZYwvZQ3qcQ%3D)** ****

You may or may not know, friend, that I never intended to become Colorado’s Senator.
When I was tapped to fill the vacant seat in Congress, I was working as the Superintendent of Denver Public Schools — and I loved it.
A strong education is one of the most important things in the world. It gives our kids the tools to learn, grow, and succeed.
As superintendent, I helped make quality education accessible to every Denver child. When I left the job to become Senator, enrollment, graduation rates, and test scores were up — but I knew my work wasn’t finished.

In the Senate, I have continued to advocate for our America's children. From making higher education more accessible to all students to my continued fight to pass the expanded Child Tax Credit, our kids' futures remain my highest priority.
My appointment to the Senate was an opportunity to help build a better future for our children, regardless of their race, gender, or socioeconomic background.
This work started long before I came to DC, and it’s far from over.
At the end of this month, my campaign has a critical quarterly fundraising deadline. If we’re going to elect Democratic majorities who will invest in schools and educators and support working families and kids, we need your support. Can you chip in now? A strong education is one of the most important things in the world. It gives our kids the tools to learn, grow, and succeed. As superintendent, I helped make quality education accessible to every Denver child. When I left the job to become Senator, enrollment, graduation rates, and test scores were up — but I knew my work wasn’t finished. [] [] Photo credit to the New York Times In the Senate, I have continued to advocate for our America's children. From making higher education more accessible to all students to my continued fight to pass the expanded Child Tax Credit, our kids' futures remain my highest priority. My appointment to the Senate was an opportunity to help build a better future for our children, regardless of their race, gender, or socioeconomic background. This work started long before I came to DC, and it’s far from over. At the end of this month, my campaign has a critical quarterly fundraising deadline. If we’re going to elect Democratic majorities who will invest in schools and educators and support working families and kids, we need your support. Can you chip in now? Peter, this headline is incredible: **_Battleground States See Spike in Voter Registration_** _“Remarkable”...”genuine, authentic enthusiasm”...”Nuts.”_ That’s how people on the ground are describing the wave of voter registration since Vice President Harris announced her candidacy. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, our people-powered campaign is strong and growing stronger by the day. **But here’s why we’re still worried:** Polling shows this race is statistically tied. The MAGA Right is outspending us to plaster the airwaves with attack ads. And time is running out before our next FEC quarterly filing deadline. Thousands of people are registering to vote each and every day, and that’s fantastic, but we still need to do the important work of earning their votes for Vice President Harris. It's up to us to reach them with our message -- and counteract the message coming from the Trump campaign -- before they cast their ballots. And that takes serious resources, Peter. It looks like you’re still waiting to make your first contribution to our campaign. At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we’re fighting like hell to elect leaders who have made it their mission to take on these Big Oil giants. One of our endorsed climate champions is **Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson.** His administration has made headlines by suing major oil and gas companies for intentionally misleading the public about the harms of their products and demanding reparations for climate-related damages.
Mayor Johnson’s lawsuit is part of a broader movement where cities and states around the country are stepping up to hold fossil fuel giants accountable in court. This is just the beginning. The industry has evaded responsibility for too long, but the tide is turning.
**We want to know if you’re with us. Do you agree with the majority of U.S. voters who support climate litigation against Big Oil?**

One of our endorsed climate champions is Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson. His administration has made headlines by suing major oil and gas companies for intentionally misleading the public about the harms of their products and demanding reparations for climate-related damages. Mayor Johnson’s lawsuit is part of a broader movement where cities and states around the country are stepping up to hold fossil fuel giants accountable in court. This is just the beginning. The industry has evaded responsibility for too long, but the tide is turning. We want to know if you’re with us. body:
I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=0b67fd8352734bf7a7e1dbdeeb81f394&_e=1n-UPYIAJFRC3cvF7YOw8Tt-S9znurya2BEjRN_qJIgotvyYaPx6A54sK3E-5RVLB85WDsShI-S3bBgvl8dPg0mdZ2peISDcDPgIfXptG74km_rkjRHKvdaJd34DfVb1DwOhMmiVx1gVhl8ogKSlUwp0QCIx3kJ8e5MqFpLni82xQ4tCVGGXhpJKiE3AecT-8T4d04jKGfhkJX54vWgaNshWuxrhp4lqQxyQQ3Lpr95RbG-VSsJ3urTKS00uB44_uRg6cyqQuQo6AUdA_VLw5jjxsA8NpkceSD2neKECrqXEkvTxUyCQVhpH-qe-u4Woq1s7ZxwxS0Td-k-D-f3iYJWNm7gNIQxYwiVOeT104qD1NpHqO7ptXpBKAT2bBHa38XYPje2kvVKAn1qilanSnQ%3D%3D)

Peter,

I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=0b67fd8352734bf7a7e1dbdeeb81f394&_e=1n-UPYIAJFRC3cvF7YOw8Tt-S9znurya2BEjRN_qJIgotvyYaPx6A54sK3E-5RVLB85WDsShI-S3bBgvl8dPg0mdZ2peISDcDPgIfXptG74km_rkjRHKvdaJd34DfVb1DwOhMmiVx1gVhl8ogKSlUwp0QCIx3kJ8e5MqFpLni82xQ4tCVGGXhpJKiE3AecT-8T4d04jKGfhkJX54vWgaNshWuxrhp4lqQxyQQ3Lpr95RbG-VSsJ3urTKS00uB44_srMMuPewawNHzr3dcrag5ZYQHnjol3Z0_NXGTlWfy4fV2c8h8INacVFpNF7B8T4x1eTeuZV4nAPBO3cpUsnjpDpOF4gLj1Q14aL_hHxbJA1MX0jhxU13HVcj3PXOlKlxvLGLON0TC-XWhm2FkkVyKw%3D%3D)

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=0b67fd8352734bf7a7e1dbdeeb81f394&_e=1n-UPYIAJFRC3cvF7YOw8Tt-S9znurya2BEjRN_qJIgotvyYaPx6A54sK3E-5RVLB85WDsShI-S3bBgvl8dPg0mdZ2peISDcDPgIfXptG74km_rkjRHKvdaJd34DfVb1DwOhMmiVx1gVhl8ogKSlUwp0QCIx3kJ8e5MqFpLni82xQ4tCVGGXhpJKiE3AecT-8T4d04jKGfhkJX54vWgaNshWuxrhp4lqQxyQQ3Lpr95RbG-VSsJ3urTKS00uB44_AuSEXXoMeTWx4FgLQFmrHpmHgRf08n4VvxV40fhUwUgtzEgfHrABUqdxG8yLTlH7iK4qTtOtU5dq-Xv25fA98ch0FzVUiKCOJ0dzd6r_W2QKDB4aMqzjIIaB2kTRJ9r7WtoazMkoEj9chcr1O_ch9Q%3D%3D)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

# [The Occam's Razor Election](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=111730&post_id=149296351&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ5Mjk2MzUxLCJpYXQiOjE3MjczMDcyMzIsImV4cCI6MTcyOTg5OTIzMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTExMTczMCIsInN1YiI6InBvc3QtcmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.uhxGJPuOBLv_2Jm21eGaHKQNVlTEuO83uqaTcN331gI)
### 6 weeks out from Election Day, cost of living is still voters' #1 concern, Harris's economic message sucks, and everything else cancels out. If he stays alive, Trump will win.
| | [Aditya Pai](https://substack.com/@adityapai)

| Sep 25
